    mimeType: string
    fileSize: integer
    width: integer
    height: integer
    checksum: string
    transformations: list
    cdnUrl: string
    altText: dict
    uploadedBy: string
    uploadedAt: datetime
    exifData: dict

Entity SEOProfile
    documentId: string
    metaTitle: string
    metaDescription: string
    canonicalUrl: string
    ogTags: dict
    schemaMarkup: dict
    focusKeywords: list
    readabilityScore: float
    keywordDensity: dict
    internalLinks: list
    lastAnalyzed: datetime

Behavior AuthorContent
    Input:
        documentId: string
        userId: string
        content: string
        changeDescription: string
    Output:
        newVersion: integer
        versionId: string
        conflictDetected: boolean
    Action:
        Retrieve current document and latest version
        Check for concurrent edit conflicts via version comparison
        If conflict, attempt automatic merge for non-overlapping changes
        Create new content version with full content snapshot
        Compute diff from parent version and store compressed
        Generate content checksum for integrity verification
        Update document metadata (last editor, version number)
        Trigger autosave confirmation to all active editing sessions
        Return new version number with conflict status

Behavior TransitionWorkflow
    Input:
        instanceId: string
        targetState: string
        userId: string
        comment: string
    Output:
        transitionResult: dict
        newState: string
        pendingActions: list
    Action:
        Validate user has required role for this transition
        Verify target state is a valid transition from current state
        Check all prerequisite conditions for target state
        Apply state transition with timestamp and actor recording
        If target state requires parallel approvals, create approval tasks
        If target state is publish, trigger publication pipeline
        Check escalation timer reset for new state
        Notify assigned roles of state change
        Return transition result with pending approval list

Behavior ManageLocalization
    Input:
        baseDocumentId: string
        targetLocale: string
        operation: string
        payload: dict
    Output:
        localizationResult: dict
        syncStatus: dict
    Action:
        Retrieve base document and all locale variants
        If creating new locale variant, clone structure from base
        If syncing, compare source version with locale synced version
        Generate change diff for translator review
        Update translation status based on sync state
        Track completion percentage per locale variant
        If source updated mid-translation, flag needs-update
        Return localization result with synchronization details

Behavior AnalyzeSEO
    Input:
        documentId: string
        content: string
        targetKeywords: list
    Output:
        seoScore: float
        recommendations: list
        metadata: dict
    Action:
        Extract and validate meta title (length, keyword inclusion)
        Analyze meta description quality and length
        Calculate keyword density and distribution across content
        Evaluate readability score using Flesch-Kincaid or equivalent
        Check heading structure (H1 uniqueness, H2-H6 hierarchy)
        Validate internal and external link quality
        Generate schema.org markup suggestions based on content type
        Compute Open Graph tags from content metadata
        Produce prioritized recommendations with estimated impact
        Return SEO analysis with score and actionable recommendations

Behavior TransformMedia
    Input:
        assetId: string
        transformationType: string
        parameters: dict
    Output:
        transformedAssetId: string
        cdnUrl: string
    Action:
        Retrieve original asset from immutable storage
        Validate transformation parameters against allowed operations
        Check if identical transformation already exists (idempotency)
        Apply transformation (resize, crop, format convert, watermark, compress)
        Verify output asset integrity via checksum comparison
        Upload transformed asset to CDN with cache headers
        Record transformation in asset metadata for reproducibility
        Return transformed asset reference with CDN URL

Behavior GenerateSitemap
    Input:
        siteId: string
        locale: string
    Output:
        sitemapUrl: string
        entryCount: integer
        lastModified: datetime
    Action:
        Retrieve all published content documents for site and locale
        Sort entries by last modified date
        Generate XML sitemap with proper namespace and schema
        Include hreflang references for multilingual pages
        Apply changefreq and priority based on content type and freshness
        Split into multiple sitemap files if entry count exceeds 50000
        Generate sitemap index referencing all split files
        Upload to CDN and ping search engines
        Return sitemap URL with entry statistics

Condition
    When content has been in draft state for more than 14 days
    Then notify author with reminder, suggest scheduling or archiving,
         escalate to editor if draft remains untouched for 30 days

Condition
    When workflow approval step exceeds 48 hours without action
    Then escalate to backup approver or administrator, send reminder to
         original assignee, update workflow instance escalation level

Condition
    When base document is published while locale translations are incomplete
    Then publish available locales, flag incomplete locales with translation
         pending indicator, queue incomplete locales for priority translation,
         update locale variant sync status

Condition
    When media asset upload exceeds maximum allowed file size for its type
    Then reject upload with descriptive error, suggest compression or
         alternative format, offer automatic optimization option for images

Condition
    When SEO analysis detects duplicate meta descriptions across published pages
    Then flag all affected documents, generate unique meta description suggestions,
         alert content team, and block publication until resolved

Event
    On ContentPublished
    Action: Update sitemap, invalidate CDN cache, trigger SEO analysis, notify
            subscribers, update search index, generate social media preview

Event
    On VersionRollback
    Action: Create new version from target rollback version, update document
            current version reference, notify editors, validate internal links,
            regenerate SEO metadata

Event
    On TranslationCompleted
    Action: Update locale variant status to ready, trigger localization sync
            check, schedule for publication if auto-publish enabled, notify
            translation coordinator

Event
    On WorkflowStuck
    Action: Identify blocking step, escalate to administrator, suggest override
            options, log workflow health metric, trigger workflow health dashboard

Event
    On MediaAssetCorrupted
    Action: Quarantine affected asset, attempt recovery from immutable original,
            alert media operations team, check transformation pipeline health,
            suspend similar transformations pending investigation

Parallel
    Content version creation and diff computation
    Workflow state transitions across multiple documents
    SEO analysis batch processing for published content
    Media transformation pipeline for multiple assets concurrently
    Sitemap generation and search engine notification
    Translation synchronization across locale variants

Optimize
    Target: Content save latency
    Priority: Version creation is write-path critical; diff computation can be
              deferred; checksum verification must be synchronous; CDN
              invalidation is asynchronous after save confirmation

Optimize
    Target: SEO analysis throughput
    Priority: Published content analyzed first; scheduled content analyzed before
              publication time; draft content analyzed on-demand only; batch
              analysis during off-peak for full site audit

Learn
    Target: Content quality scoring for SEO recommendations
    Goal: Predict search engine ranking improvement from implemented recommendations
    Adapt
        Based: Actual ranking changes after SEO recommendations implemented,
               correlation between recommendation types and traffic improvements,
               competitive analysis of similar content

Learn
    Target: Workflow bottleneck identification and resolution
    Goal: Reduce average content time-to-publish by 30% through workflow optimization
    Adapt
        Based: Workflow step duration analytics, approval delay patterns,
               content type complexity correlations, and team capacity modeling

Learn
    Target: Translation cost and quality optimization
    Goal: Minimize translation cost while maintaining quality score above 95%
    Adapt
        Based: Translation quality scores by provider and language pair,
               source content change frequency patterns, and machine translation
               improvement tracking over time

Security
    Encrypt: Content in transit and at rest, version snapshots, translation
             payloads, workflow state data, SEO credential storage
    Protect: Content access controls, version integrity, workflow authorization,
             media asset immutability, sitemap tampering prevention

Security
    Encrypt: Media transformation pipelines, CDN authentication tokens,
             search engine API credentials, translation service credentials
    Protect: Content injection prevention, XSS sanitization for rich content,
             media asset provenance tracking, unauthorized publication prevention,
             workflow privilege escalation detection

interface ContentDocument {
    documentId: string;
    title: string;
    slug: string;
    contentType: string;
    currentVersion: number;
    authorId: string;
    lastEditorId: string;
    status: 'draft' | 'review' | 'approved' | 'published' | 'archived';
    locale: string;
    baseDocumentId: string;
    createdAt: Date;
    publishedAt: Date | null;
    scheduledAt: Date | null;
    seoMetadata: SEOMetadata;
}

interface ContentVersion {
    versionId: string;
    documentId: string;
    versionNumber: number;
    content: string;
    editorId: string;
    changeDescription: string;
    createdAt: Date;
    parentVersionId: string | null;
    checksum: string;
}

interface WorkflowState {
    stateName: string;
    allowedRoles: string[];
    transitions: WorkflowTransition[];
    timeLimit?: number;
    escalationTarget?: string;
}

interface WorkflowTransition {
    targetState: string;
    requiredRole: string;
    conditions?: ((doc: ContentDocument) => boolean)[];
}

class ContentVersionManager {
    private versions: Map<string, ContentVersion[]> = new Map();

    createVersion(
        documentId: string,
        content: string,
        editorId: string,
        description: string
    ): ContentVersion {
        const docVersions = this.versions.get(documentId) || [];
        const versionNumber = docVersions.length + 1;
        const parentVersion = docVersions[docVersions.length - 1];

        const version: ContentVersion = {
            versionId: `${documentId}_v${versionNumber}`,
            documentId,
            versionNumber,
            content,
            editorId,
            changeDescription: description,
            createdAt: new Date(),
            parentVersionId: parentVersion?.versionId || null,
            checksum: this.computeChecksum(content),
        };

        docVersions.push(version);
        this.versions.set(documentId, docVersions);
        return version;
    }

    rollback(documentId: string, targetVersion: number): ContentVersion {
        const docVersions = this.versions.get(documentId) || [];
        const target = docVersions.find(v => v.versionNumber === targetVersion);
        if (!target) throw new Error(`Version ${targetVersion} not found`);

        return this.createVersion(
            documentId,
            target.content,
            target.editorId,
            `Rollback to version ${targetVersion}`
        );
    }

    private computeChecksum(content: string): string {
        let hash = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < content.length; i++) {
            const char = content.charCodeAt(i);
            hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + char;
            hash |= 0;
        }
        return hash.toString(16);
    }
}

class SEOAnalyzer {
    analyzeMetaTitle(title: string, keywords: string[]): { score: number; issues: string[] } {
        const issues: string[] = [];
        let score = 100;
        if (title.length < 30) { issues.push('Title too short'); score -= 20; }
        if (title.length > 60) { issues.push('Title too long'); score -= 15; }
        const hasKeyword = keywords.some(kw => title.toLowerCase().includes(kw.toLowerCase()));
        if (!hasKeyword) { issues.push('No target keyword in title'); score -= 25; }
        return { score: Math.max(0, score), issues };
    }
}
}

# AICL Example: Live Auction Platform
# Real-time bidding, reserve prices, anti-sniping, payment escrow, and multiple auction types

Goal
    Build a live auction platform that supports real-time bidding with sub-second latency,
    enforces reserve prices with transparency controls, implements anti-sniping extensions,
    manages payment escrow with trust verification, and supports multiple auction types
    including English, Dutch, sealed-bid, and Vickrey auctions with comprehensive audit trails.

Constraint
    Bid submission to confirmation must complete within 500ms
    Anti-sniping extension must trigger automatically and notify all bidders
    Reserve price must be enforced without revealing to bidders when not met
    Escrow funds must be locked within 2 seconds of auction close
    Auction state machine must be strictly enforced with no invalid transitions
    All auction results must be verifiable and auditable with complete bid history

Risk
    Bid sniping in final seconds prevents fair competition
Recovery
    Implement automatic time extension: if bid placed within last 2 minutes, extend
    auction by 2 minutes; cap maximum extensions at 3; notify all active bidders of
    time extension with updated countdown; log extension trigger for audit

Risk
    Winning bidder defaults on payment after auction close
Recovery
    Require pre-authorized payment method before bidding; lock escrow deposit of 10%
    at bid time; on default, forfeit deposit to seller; offer second-chance to next
    highest bidder; record default on bidder's trust profile

Risk
    Shill bidding artificially inflates auction prices
Recovery
    Detect shill patterns via bid behavior analysis (same IP, device fingerprint,
    bid timing patterns); flag suspicious bidding for review; suspend flagged accounts;
    cancel auctions with confirmed shill activity; refund affected bidders

Risk
    Payment escrow fails to release funds after successful auction
Recovery
    Implement automated escrow release with time-based triggers; if seller verification
    complete, auto-release after 48 hours; allow buyer confirmation for early release;
    escalate unresolved escrow to dispute resolution team; maintain full transaction log

Risk
    Concurrent bid submission creates race condition on current price
Recovery
    Implement optimistic concurrency control with version-based conflict detection;
    on conflict, reject lower bid and notify bidder of current price; process bids in
    strict chronological order with microsecond precision timestamps; maintain bid
    queue with single-writer pattern for each auction

Risk
    Auction type misconfiguration leads to incorrect winner determination
Recovery
    Validate auction configuration against type-specific schema before activation;
    simulate auction with test bids to verify outcome logic; require administrator
    confirmation for non-standard configurations; maintain type-specific test suites

Layer
    SubLayer: BiddingLayer
        Bid submission, validation, queue processing, current price tracking
    SubLayer: AuctionLayer
        Auction lifecycle, type-specific logic, state machine, timer management
    SubLayer: AntiSnipeLayer
        Time extension triggers, notification dispatch, extension counting
    SubLayer: EscrowLayer
        Payment authorization, fund locking, release triggers, refund processing
    SubLayer: TrustLayer
        Bidder verification, reputation scoring, fraud detection, dispute resolution
    SubLayer: AuditLayer
        Bid history, state transitions, payment records, compliance reporting

Validation
    Every bid must be higher than current bid plus minimum increment for English auctions
    Reserve price status (met/unmet) must never be revealed until auction ends
    Anti-sniping extension must trigger consistently for all qualifying bids
    Escrow balance must always equal sum of locked deposits for active auctions
    Auction state transitions must follow defined state machine with no skips
    Sealed-bid auctions must never reveal bid amounts before closing
    All monetary calculations must use fixed-point arithmetic with no floating point

Entity Auction
    auctionId: string
    sellerId: string
    title: string
    description: string
    auctionType: string
    startingPrice: float
    currentPrice: float
    reservePrice: float
    reserveMet: boolean
    minimumIncrement: float
    startTime: datetime
    endTime: datetime
    status: string
    extensionCount: integer
    maxExtensions: integer
    category: string

Entity Bid
    bidId: string
    auctionId: string
    bidderId: string
    amount: float
    timestamp: datetime
    isWinning: boolean
    isReserveMet: boolean
    bidType: string
    deviceFingerprint: string
    ipAddress: string

Entity EscrowTransaction
    escrowId: string
    auctionId: string
    buyerId: string
    sellerId: string
    amount: float
    depositAmount: float
    status: string
    lockedAt: datetime
    releaseAt: datetime
    releasedAt: datetime
    disputeId: string

Entity BidderProfile
    bidderId: string
    reputationScore: float
    totalBids: integer

package auction

import (
    "sync"
    "time"
)

type AuctionType string

const (
    EnglishAuction  AuctionType = "english"
    DutchAuction    AuctionType = "dutch"
    SealedBidAuction AuctionType = "sealed"
    VickreyAuction  AuctionType = "vickrey"
)

type AuctionStatus string

const (
    StatusDraft     AuctionStatus = "draft"
    StatusActive    AuctionStatus = "active"
    StatusExtended  AuctionStatus = "extended"
    StatusClosed    AuctionStatus = "closed"
    StatusCancelled AuctionStatus = "cancelled"
)

type Bid struct {
    BidID        string
    AuctionID    string
    BidderID     string
    Amount       int64 // fixed-point in cents
    Timestamp    time.Time
    IsWinning    bool
    ReserveMet   bool
    IPHash       string
}

type Auction struct {
    AuctionID       string
    SellerID        string
    AuctionType     AuctionType
    Status          AuctionStatus
    StartingPrice   int64
    CurrentPrice    int64
    ReservePrice    int64
    ReserveMet      bool
    MinIncrement    int64
    StartTime       time.Time
    EndTime         time.Time
    ExtensionCount  int
    MaxExtensions   int
    bids            []Bid
    mu              sync.Mutex
}

func (a *Auction) SubmitBid(bidderID string, amount int64) (*Bid, bool) {
    a.mu.Lock()
    defer a.mu.Unlock()

    if a.Status != StatusActive && a.Status != StatusExtended {
        return nil, false
    }

    minBid := a.CurrentPrice + a.MinIncrement
    if amount < minBid {
        return nil, false
    }

    // Mark previous winning bid as no longer winning
    for i := range a.bids {
        a.bids[i].IsWinning = false
    }

    bid := Bid{
        BidID:     GenerateBidID(),
        AuctionID: a.AuctionID,
        BidderID:  bidderID,
        Amount:    amount,
        Timestamp: time.Now(),
        IsWinning: true,
        ReserveMet: amount >= a.ReservePrice,
    }

    a.bids = append(a.bids, bid)
    a.CurrentPrice = amount
    if amount >= a.ReservePrice {
        a.ReserveMet = true
    }

    // Anti-sniping: extend if bid within 2 minutes of end
    timeUntilEnd := a.EndTime.Sub(time.Now())
    if timeUntilEnd < 2*time.Minute && a.ExtensionCount < a.MaxExtensions {
        a.EndTime = a.EndTime.Add(2 * time.Minute)
        a.ExtensionCount++
        a.Status = StatusExtended
    }

    return &bid, true
}

func (a *Auction) Close() *AuctionResult {
    a.mu.Lock()
    defer a.mu.Unlock()

    a.Status = StatusClosed
    var winningBid *Bid
    for i := range a.bids {
        if a.bids[i].IsWinning {
            winningBid = &a.bids[i]
            break
        }
    }

    return &AuctionResult{
        AuctionID:     a.AuctionID,
        WinningBid:    winningBid,
        FinalPrice:    a.CurrentPrice,
        ReserveMet:    a.ReserveMet,
        TotalBids:     len(a.bids),
        Extensions:    a.ExtensionCount,
    }
}

type AuctionResult struct {
    AuctionID  string
    WinningBid *Bid
    FinalPrice int64
    ReserveMet bool
    TotalBids  int
    Extensions int
}

func GenerateBidID() string {
    return time.Now().Format("20060102150405") + RandomSuffix(8)
}

func RandomSuffix(n int) string {
    // simplified
    return "abcd1234"
}
}

# AICL Example: Podcast Platform
# Audio processing, RSS feeds, transcription, ad insertion, analytics, and discovery

Goal
    Build a podcast platform that handles professional audio processing with loudness
    normalization and enhancement, manages RSS feed generation and distribution to all
    major directories, provides automated transcription with speaker diarization, supports
    dynamic ad insertion with targeting, delivers comprehensive analytics for creators,
    and powers content discovery through topic modeling and listener behavior analysis.

Constraint
    Audio processing must normalize to -16 LUFS for spoken content within 1 LU tolerance
    RSS feed generation must complete within 5 seconds of any episode metadata change
    Transcription must achieve at least 95% word accuracy for clear English speech
    Dynamic ad insertion must be seamless with no audible artifacts at splice points
    Analytics must be available within 5 minutes of listening event ingestion
    Discovery recommendations must be generated within 200ms per user request

Risk
    Audio normalization introduces artifacts or degrades speech intelligibility
Recovery
    Apply multi-pass normalization with speech-weighted filtering; validate output
    with PESQ score; if quality below threshold, fall back to simpler normalization;
    maintain original audio for reprocessing; alert audio engineering team on repeated failures

Risk
    RSS feed distribution delays cause episodes to be unavailable on directories
Recovery
    Implement webhook-based push notifications to directories; poll directories for
    feed update verification; if push fails, retry with exponential backoff; maintain
    direct submission API integration for major platforms; alert creator of distribution delay

Risk
    Transcription service outage blocks episode processing pipeline
Recovery
    Queue transcription jobs for deferred processing; mark episodes as transcription
    pending; enable episode publication without transcription; process transcription
    asynchronously when service recovers; notify creator when transcription available

Risk
    Ad insertion targeting leaks listener personal data to advertisers
Recovery
    Implement server-side ad decisioning with anonymized audience segments; never expose
    individual listener data; use differential privacy for audience reporting; audit ad
    targeting parameters for compliance; enforce data minimization in ad request payloads

Risk
    Analytics data inconsistency between real-time and batch-processed metrics
Recovery
    Use Lambda architecture with speed and batch layers; reconcile speed layer results
    with batch processing hourly; flag discrepancies exceeding 2% for investigation;
    serve speed layer data with appropriate confidence indicators; maintain immutable
    event log as source of truth

Risk
    Content discovery algorithm amplifies popular podcasts at expense of niche content
Recovery
    Implement diversity injection in recommendation ranking; allocate minimum 25% of
    recommendation slots to discovery content; track and optimize for catalog coverage;
    provide niche category boosting; monitor recommendation entropy metrics

Layer
    SubLayer: AudioLayer
        Audio ingestion, normalization, enhancement, format conversion, chapter marking
    SubLayer: FeedLayer
        RSS generation, directory distribution, feed validation, metadata management
    SubLayer: TranscriptionLayer
        Speech-to-text, speaker diarization, timestamp alignment, language detection
    SubLayer: AdLayer
        Ad decisioning, dynamic insertion, targeting, frequency capping, compliance
    SubLayer: AnalyticsLayer
        Event ingestion, metric computation, creator dashboard, export, benchmarking
    SubLayer: DiscoveryLayer
        Topic modeling, similarity matching, listener profiling, recommendation ranking

Validation
    All published audio must meet -16 LUFS loudness target within 1 LU tolerance
    RSS feeds must validate against Apple Podcasts and Spotify specifications
    Transcription timestamps must align within 500ms of actual speech boundaries
    Ad insertion splice points must be inaudible with crossfade validation
    Analytics event processing must maintain exactly-once semantics
    Discovery recommendations must include at least 25% catalog-diverse content
    All creator-facing metrics must be reconcilable to raw event data

class AudioProcessor:
    TARGET_LUFS = -16.0
    LUFS_TOLERANCE = 1.0

    def normalize_loudness(self, input_lufs: float, content: bytes) -> Tuple[float, bytes]:
        adjustment = self.TARGET_LUFS - input_lufs
        if abs(input_lufs - self.TARGET_LUFS) <= self.LUFS_TOLERANCE:
            return input_lufs, content
        # Apply gain adjustment (simplified)
        new_lufs = input_lufs + adjustment
        return new_lufs, content

    def validate_loudness(self, measured_lufs: float) -> bool:
        return abs(measured_lufs - self.TARGET_LUFS) <= self.LUFS_TOLERANCE

    def detect_chapters(self, silence_gaps: List[Tuple[float, float]],
                        min_gap_duration: float = 2.0) -> List[dict]:
        chapters = []
        chapter_start = 0.0
        for i, (start, end) in enumerate(silence_gaps):
            if end - start >= min_gap_duration:
                chapters.append({
                    "title": f"Chapter {i + 1}",
                    "start_time": chapter_start,
                    "end_time": start,
                })
                chapter_start = end
        return chapters

class RSSFeedGenerator:
    def generate_feed(self, podcast: Podcast, episodes: List[Episode]) -> str:
        items = []
        for ep in episodes:
            if ep.status != EpisodeStatus.PUBLISHED:
                continue
            items.append(f"""
    <item>
        <title>{ep.title}</title>
        <description>{ep.description}</description>
        <enclosure url="{ep.audio_url}" length="{ep.file_size}" type="audio/mpeg"/>
        <pubDate>{ep.publish_date.strftime('%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT')}</pubDate>
        <itunes:duration>{int(ep.duration)}</itunes:duration>
        <itunes:season>{ep.season}</itunes:season>
        <itunes:episode>{ep.episode_number}</itunes:episode>
    </item>""")

        return f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rss version="2.0" xmlns:itunes="http://www.itunes.com/dtds/podcast-1.0.dtd">
<channel>
    <title>{podcast.title}</title>
    <description>{podcast.description}</description>
    <itunes:category text="{podcast.category}"/>
    <itunes:owner>
        <itunes:email>creator@platform.com</itunes:email>
    </itunes:owner>
    <language>{podcast.language}</language>
    {''.join(items)}
</channel>
</rss>"""

class AdDecisioningEngine:
    def select_ad(self, listener_segment: str, frequency_caps: Dict[str, int],
                  eligible_campaigns: List[dict]) -> Optional[dict]:
        for campaign in sorted(eligible_campaigns, key=lambda c: c.get("bid", 0), reverse=True):
            campaign_id = campaign["campaign_id"]
            if frequency_caps.get(campaign_id, 0) < campaign.get("frequency_cap", 3):
                return campaign
        return None

# AICL Example: Hospital Management System
# Comprehensive hospital management covering patient records, appointments, billing, pharmacy, lab results, and staff scheduling

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Provide an integrated hospital management system that unifies patient records, appointment scheduling, billing, pharmacy operations, laboratory results, and staff management to deliver efficient, safe, and high-quality healthcare services.

Constraint: System must comply with HIPAA regulations, ensure 99.9% uptime for critical patient data, and maintain sub-2-second response time for clinical queries.

Constraint: All patient data must remain within jurisdictional boundaries and support audit trails for every data access event.

Constraint: Billing must integrate with insurance providers via HL7/FHIR standards and support multiple payment methods.

Risk: System downtime during peak emergency hours could delay critical patient care and treatment decisions.
Recovery: Deploy active-active redundant infrastructure with automatic failover; maintain read-only cached patient records on edge nodes for emergency access during outages.

Risk: Unauthorized access to patient health information could result in HIPAA violations and privacy breaches.
Recovery: Implement zero-trust architecture with multi-factor authentication; activate real-time access anomaly detection; automatically revoke compromised credentials and notify compliance officers within 15 minutes.

Risk: Pharmacy dispensing errors due to incorrect medication orders could cause patient harm or death.
Recovery: Implement barcode verification and three-point cross-check system; alert pharmacist and prescribing physician immediately upon discrepancy detection; auto-quarantine flagged prescriptions until verified.

Risk: Billing discrepancies from insurance claim rejections could cause revenue cycle disruption.
Recovery: Maintain automated claim scrubbing with pre-submission validation; escrow contested claims for manual review; generate corrective claim resubmission within 24 hours.

Risk: Staff scheduling gaps during surge periods could compromise patient-to-staff ratios and care quality.
Recovery: Deploy predictive staffing models with float pool activation; enable automated shift-swap system with minimum coverage guarantees; trigger agency staff requests when ratios fall below threshold.

Risk: Lab result delivery delays could postpone critical diagnoses and treatment decisions.
Recovery: Implement priority result routing for critical values; establish direct lab-to-physician notification pipeline with 15-minute SLA; maintain backup manual reporting protocol for system failures.

Layer: HospitalManagementSystem
    SubLayer: ClinicalServices
        # Patient management, clinical workflows, order entry
    SubLayer: AdministrativeServices
        # Billing, insurance, scheduling, reporting
    SubLayer: PharmacyServices
        # Medication management, dispensing, inventory
    SubLayer: LaboratoryServices
        # Lab orders, results, specimen tracking
    SubLayer: StaffServices
        # Scheduling, credentials, payroll integration

Validation: Patient record integrity verified via checksum comparison on every read/write operation.
Validation: Appointment scheduling conflicts detected and prevented before confirmation.
Validation: Billing calculations validated against insurance fee schedules with zero-tolerance for overcharges.
Validation: Medication dispensing verified against active prescriptions and allergy profiles.
Validation: Staff credentials and certifications verified before shift assignment.
Validation: Lab result critical values trigger automatic physician notification within 15 minutes.
Validation: System access logs audited daily for unauthorized access patterns.

# === LEVEL 2: ENTITIES ===

# === LEVEL 3: BEHAVIORS ===

Behavior RegisterPatient
    Input: patientData: dict, registrationSource: string, insuranceInfo: dict
    Output: patientRecord: dict, registrationConfirmation: string
    Action:
        Validate patient demographic data against required fields
        Verify insurance eligibility via payer portal integration
        Check for duplicate patient records using fuzzy matching algorithm
        Create patient record in master patient index
        Assign unique patient identifier with checksum
        Generate registration confirmation and welcome packet
        Notify primary physician of new patient registration

Behavior ScheduleAppointment
    Input: patientId: string, physicianId: string, preferredDateTime: datetime, appointmentType: string, reason: string
    Output: appointmentConfirmation: dict, conflictAlerts: list
    Action:
        Query physician availability calendar for requested time slot
        Check room and equipment availability for appointment type
        Validate insurance pre-authorization requirements
        Detect scheduling conflicts with existing appointments
        Apply priority scheduling rules for urgent cases
        Confirm appointment and send notifications to all parties
        Update physician workload tracking and department census

Behavior ProcessBillingClaim
    Input: encounterId: string, serviceCodes: list, diagnosisCodes: list, insuranceId: string
    Output: claimId: string, submissionStatus: string, estimatedReimbursement: float
    Action:
        Validate CPT and ICD-10 code combinations for medical necessity
        Calculate charges based on fee schedule and contracted rates
        Apply insurance rules for copay, coinsurance, and deductible
        Scrub claim for common rejection reasons before submission
        Submit electronic claim to insurance payer via EDI 837
        Track claim status and generate appeals for denials
        Post payment to patient account upon adjudication

Behavior DispenseMedication
    Input: orderId: string, pharmacyId: string, pharmacistId: string, verificationCode: string
    Output: dispenseConfirmation: dict, interactionWarnings: list
    Action:
        Retrieve and validate medication order against active prescriptions
        Perform drug-drug and drug-allergy interaction screening
        Verify dosage and frequency against clinical guidelines
        Cross-reference patient weight, renal function, and age for dose appropriateness
        Generate barcode for medication tracking
        Record dispense event with pharmacist verification
        Update inventory levels and trigger reorder if below threshold

Behavior ManageLabResults
    Input: labOrderId: string, resultData: dict, technicianId: string
    Output: resultConfirmation: dict, criticalAlerts: list, physicianNotification: string
    Action:
        Validate result data against expected ranges and quality controls
        Apply critical value thresholds and trigger immediate alerts
        Compare current results with patient historical values for delta checks
        Route results to ordering physician with interpretation assistance
        Update patient record with verified lab results
        Generate quality assurance metrics for laboratory accreditation
        Archive results in compliance with retention requirements

Behavior GenerateStaffSchedule
    Input: departmentId: string, periodStart: datetime, periodEnd: datetime, staffingRules: dict
    Output: schedule: dict, coverageGaps: list, overtimeAlerts: list
    Action:
        Analyze historical patient volume patterns for staffing prediction
        Apply minimum staffing ratios per department and shift
        Respect staff availability preferences and constraints
        Validate credential requirements for each assignment
        Distribute shifts equitably considering overtime limits
        Identify coverage gaps and generate float pool requests
        Publish schedule and send notifications to affected staff

Behavior AdmitPatient
    Input: patientId: string, admittingPhysicianId: string, departmentId: string, admissionType: string, diagnosisCodes: list
    Output: admissionRecord: dict, bedAssignment: string, ordersGenerated: list
    Action:
        Verify patient identity and insurance coverage
        Determine bed availability and assign appropriate room
        Generate standard admission order set based on diagnosis
        Notify nursing station and pharmacy of new admission
        Initiate nursing assessment workflow
        Create encounter record linking all subsequent activities
        Begin real-time location tracking for patient safety

# === LEVEL 4: CONDITIONS ===

Condition: CriticalLabResultAlert
    When lab result value exceeds critical threshold defined for test code and patient demographics
    Then escalate result to ordering physician via secure page, SMS, and in-app alert within 5 minutes; log escalation timestamp; if no acknowledgment within 15 minutes, escalate to department chief and on-call supervisor

Condition: AppointmentOverbooking
    When appointment demand exceeds physician capacity by more than 10% for any given day
    Then activate overflow scheduling protocol; open additional time slots with covering physician; notify scheduling team of capacity breach; generate report for resource planning review

Condition: InsuranceClaimDenial
    When insurance claim is denied with reason code indicating medical necessity or authorization issues
    Then automatically generate appeal letter with supporting clinical documentation; route to billing specialist for review; set 48-hour SLA for appeal submission; flag account for patient balance hold pending resolution

Condition: MedicationInteractionDetected
    When drug interaction screening identifies severe or contraindicated interaction between prescribed medications
    Then halt dispensing process immediately; alert prescribing physician and pharmacist simultaneously; display interaction details with clinical evidence; require documented override justification for continued dispensing

Condition: StaffingRatioViolation
    When patient-to-nurse ratio exceeds mandated limits for any unit and shift
    Then trigger emergency staffing protocol; notify charge nurse and nursing supervisor; activate float pool and agency staff request; document ratio violation for regulatory compliance reporting; restrict new admissions until ratio is restored

Condition: PharmacyInventoryCritical
    When medication inventory level falls below safety stock threshold for critical medications
    Then generate emergency purchase order to primary distributor; identify alternative therapeutic equivalents; notify pharmacy director and clinical staff of potential shortage; activate conservation protocol for affected medications

# === LEVEL 5: EVENTS ===

Event: PatientAdmitted
    On patient admission confirmed and bed assigned
    Action: Send welcome packet to patient room; notify primary care physician; initiate nursing admission assessment; generate standard order set; begin insurance pre-certification for inpatient stay; update department census board

Event: LabResultFinalized
    On lab result verified and released by pathologist or technician
    Action: Push result to ordering physician inbox; update patient portal with non-critical results; trigger clinical decision support rules; compare against previous values for trending; generate quality control metrics

Event: InsuranceClaimAdjudicated
    On insurance payer processes and returns claim determination
    Action: Post payment or adjustment to patient account; generate patient statement for responsibility amount; update revenue cycle dashboard; trigger denial management workflow if denied; reconcile against expected reimbursement

Event: MedicationDispensed
    On pharmacy completes medication dispensing with verification
    Action: Update patient medication administration record; adjust inventory levels and costs; trigger refill reminder scheduling; log dispense event for regulatory compliance; notify nursing station of medication availability

Event: ShiftChangeInitiated
    On scheduled shift transition at department level
    Action: Generate shift handoff report with pending tasks and alerts; verify incoming staff credentials and certifications; update real-time staffing dashboard; trigger overtime calculations for outgoing shift; initiate patient safety huddle

Event: EmergencyCodeActivated
    On emergency code (Code Blue, Code Red, etc.) declared in any department
    Action: Broadcast code location to all response team members; initiate real-time event logging; notify hospital command center; activate additional staffing protocols; prepare documentation for event review committee

# === LEVEL 6: CONCURRENCY ===

Parallel:
    Patient registration and insurance eligibility verification execute concurrently to reduce check-in time
    Lab specimen collection, processing, and result validation pipeline with parallel quality control checks
    Billing charge capture running concurrently with clinical documentation for real-time claim preparation
    Pharmacy verification and inventory update executing in parallel during dispensing workflow
    Staff schedule generation and credential verification running concurrently for faster schedule publication
    Department census updates and bed management algorithms executing simultaneously
    Clinical decision support rule evaluation and alert generation running in parallel across all active patients

# === LEVEL 7: OPTIMIZATION ===

Optimize: Patient throughput from admission to discharge
    Priority: Minimize average length of stay while maintaining quality benchmarks; reduce unnecessary diagnostic delays; optimize bed turnover rate

Optimize: Revenue cycle efficiency from charge capture to payment posting
    Priority: Reduce claim denial rate below 3%; accelerate days in accounts receivable to under 35; maximize clean claim submission rate above 95%

Optimize: Pharmacy inventory management for cost and availability
    Priority: Maintain 98% medication availability rate while reducing inventory carrying costs by 15%; minimize waste from expired medications through predictive ordering

Optimize: Staff scheduling for coverage and satisfaction
    Priority: Achieve 100% compliance with mandated staffing ratios while maintaining staff satisfaction score above 4.2/5.0; reduce overtime expenditure by 20%

Optimize: Appointment utilization and no-show reduction
    Priority: Achieve physician utilization rate above 85%; reduce patient no-show rate below 8% through predictive outreach and overbooking optimization

# === LEVEL 8: LEARNING ===

Learn: Patient no-show prediction model
    Goal: Predict appointment no-show probability with greater than 80% accuracy using patient history, weather, time-of-day, and demographic features
    Adapt: Appointment overbooking strategy
    Based: No-show prediction confidence score and historical overbooking outcomes to minimize double-booking while filling cancellations

Learn: Disease outbreak pattern recognition
    Goal: Identify emerging infection patterns from emergency department presentations, lab orders, and admission data for early outbreak detection
    Adapt: Emergency department staffing and isolation protocol activation
    Based: Epidemiological indicators including symptom clusters, geographic patterns, and seasonal disease prevalence models

Learn: Medication demand forecasting
    Goal: Predict pharmacy inventory needs with 90% accuracy using seasonal illness patterns, surgical schedules, and historical dispensing data
    Adapt: Pharmacy purchasing and inventory allocation
    Based: Forecasted demand variance, supplier lead times, and critical medication availability requirements

Learn: Length of stay prediction
    Goal: Predict patient length of stay at admission with 75% accuracy using diagnosis, comorbidities, and clinical indicators
    Adapt: Discharge planning timeline and resource allocation
    Based: Predicted discharge date confidence interval and resource availability for post-acute care transitions

Learn: Claim denial pattern analysis
    Goal: Identify common denial reasons and predict claim denial probability before submission with 70% accuracy
    Adapt: Pre-submission claim scrubbing rules and clinical documentation improvement priorities
    Based: Historical denial patterns by payer, procedure, and diagnosis combination

# === LEVEL 9: SECURITY ===

Security:
    Encrypt: All patient health information at rest using AES-256 encryption and in transit using TLS 1.3
    Encrypt: Database backups and archive storage using AES-256 with separate key management
    Encrypt: Lab results and medication orders during inter-system transmission
    Protect: Patient identity data via tokenization in non-clinical systems and analytics databases
    Protect: Physician order entry with digital signature verification and tamper detection
    Protect: Billing and insurance data with field-level encryption and access logging
    Protect: Staff credential and certification records with role-based access controls
    Protect: System administrative access with hardware security key requirement and session recording
    Protect: API endpoints with OAuth 2.0, rate limiting, and request signing
    Protect: Audit logs with write-once storage and tamper-evident chaining

# === LEVEL 10: NATIVE ===

import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

class HospitalManagementSystem:
    def __init__(self, db_connection, encryption_key):
        self.db = db_connection
        self.encryption_key = encryption_key
        self.critical_value_thresholds = {}
        self.staffing_ratios = {
            "ICU": {"nurse_to_patient": 2, "min_nurses": 4},
            "MEDSURG": {"nurse_to_patient": 5, "min_nurses": 3},
            "ED": {"nurse_to_patient": 4, "min_nurses": 5},
        }

    def register_patient(self, patient_data: Dict, insurance_info: Dict) -> Dict:
        required_fields = ["firstName", "lastName", "dateOfBirth", "gender", "contactPhone"]
        for field in required_fields:
            if field not in patient_data or not patient_data[field]:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing required field: {field}")

        checksum = hashlib.sha256(
            f"{patient_data['firstName']}{patient_data['lastName']}{patient_data['dateOfBirth']}".encode()
        ).hexdigest()[:8]
        patient_id = f"PAT-{checksum}-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M')}"

        eligibility = self.verify_insurance(insurance_info)
        if not eligibility["active"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Insurance not active: {eligibility['reason']}")

        record = {
            "patientId": patient_id,
            **patient_data,
            "insuranceProviderId": insurance_info["providerId"],
            "insurancePolicyNumber": insurance_info["policyNumber"],
            "allergies": patient_data.get("allergies", []),
            "admissionStatus": "OUTPATIENT",
            "registrationDate": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }
        self.db.insert("patients", record)
        return {"patientRecord": record, "confirmation": patient_id}

    def verify_insurance(self, insurance_info: Dict) -> Dict:
        payer_response = self._call_payer_portal(
            insurance_info["providerId"],
            insurance_info["policyNumber"],
            insurance_info.get("subscriberId"),
        )
        return {
            "active": payer_response.get("coverageStatus") == "ACTIVE",
            "reason": payer_response.get("denialReason", ""),
            "copayAmount": payer_response.get("copay", 0.0),
            "deductibleRemaining": payer_response.get("deductibleRemaining", 0.0),
        }

    def check_critical_lab_value(self, test_code: str, result_value: float, patient: Dict) -> bool:
        threshold = self.critical_value_thresholds.get(test_code)
        if not threshold:
            return False
        age = (datetime.now() - datetime.fromisoformat(patient["dateOfBirth"])).days / 365.25
        if threshold.get("age_adjusted"):
            age_key = "pediatric" if age < 18 else "adult" if age < 65 else "geriatric"
            bounds = threshold["ranges"].get(age_key, threshold["ranges"].get("adult"))
        else:
            bounds = threshold["ranges"]
        return result_value < bounds["low"] or result_value > bounds["high"]

    def validate_staffing_ratio(self, department: str, current_nurses: int, current_patients: int) -> Dict:
        ratio_config = self.staffing_ratios.get(department, self.staffing_ratios["MEDSURG"])
        required_nurses = max(
            ratio_config["min_nurses"],
            -(-current_patients // ratio_config["nurse_to_patient"])
        )
        is_compliant = current_nurses >= required_nurses
        return {
            "compliant": is_compliant,
            "current_ratio": current_patients / max(current_nurses, 1),
            "required_nurses": required_nurses,
            "shortage": max(0, required_nurses - current_nurses),
        }

    def _call_payer_portal(self, provider_id, policy_number, subscriber_id=None):
        return {"coverageStatus": "ACTIVE", "copay": 25.0, "deductibleRemaining": 500.0}
}

# AICL Example: Electronic Health Records System
# FHIR-compliant EHR system with interoperability, clinical workflows, clinical decision support, and patient portal

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Deliver a FHIR R4-compliant electronic health records system that ensures seamless interoperability across healthcare providers, supports evidence-based clinical decision support, enables patient engagement through a secure portal, and maintains complete audit trails for regulatory compliance.

Constraint: System must conform to HL7 FHIR R4 specification for all data exchange interfaces and support US Core and SMART on FHIR profiles.

Constraint: Clinical decision support rules must be evidence-based, sourced from nationally recognized guidelines, and reviewed by clinical governance committee annually.

Constraint: Patient portal must provide 24/7 access with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance and support multiple languages.

Constraint: Data exchange must support C-CDA, FHIR, and Direct messaging protocols for nationwide interoperability.

Risk: Data corruption during interoperability exchange could propagate inaccurate clinical information across provider networks.
Recovery: Implement message-level checksums and digital signatures; maintain transaction logs with rollback capability; activate reconciliation daemon to detect and correct propagation errors within 1 hour; notify all affected providers of data quality issue.

Risk: Clinical decision support alert fatigue could cause providers to ignore critical safety alerts.
Recovery: Implement tiered alert severity with suppressible vs. non-suppressible classification; continuously monitor alert override rates; auto-escalate overridden critical alerts to department safety officer; adjust alert thresholds based on clinical outcomes data.

Risk: Patient portal compromise could expose sensitive health information to unauthorized parties.
Recovery: Deploy behavioral anomaly detection on portal sessions; implement session-based encryption with automatic timeout; force password reset and credential revocation upon breach detection; notify affected patients and compliance team within 1 hour per HIPAA breach notification rules.

Risk: FHIR API rate limiting failures during high-volume exchange could cause data loss or timeouts.
Recovery: Implement priority-based request queuing with clinical data taking precedence; maintain message persistence with guaranteed delivery; activate throttling with graceful degradation; retry failed exchanges with exponential backoff.

Risk: Incomplete clinical documentation could lead to billing errors, care gaps, and regulatory penalties.
Recovery: Deploy real-time documentation completeness checking with template enforcement; generate provider-specific compliance dashboards; auto-create deficiency worklists; escalate chronic documentation deficiencies to department chairs.

Risk: System migration failures during upgrades could cause extended downtime and data inaccessibility.
Recovery: Execute blue-green deployment with instant rollback capability; maintain read-only replica for emergency clinical access; complete full data validation before traffic cutover; preserve previous version for 30-day rollback window.

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any
import hashlib
import json

class FHIRServer:
    def __init__(self, database, consent_engine, cds_engine, audit_logger):
        self.db = database
        self.consent = consent_engine
        self.cds = cds_engine
        self.audit = audit_logger
        self.supported_resources = [
            "Patient", "Observation", "Condition", "MedicationRequest",
            "Procedure", "Encounter", "DocumentReference", "DiagnosticReport"
        ]
        self.profiles = {
            "Patient": "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-patient",
            "Observation": "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-observation-lab",
        }

    def create_resource(self, resource_type: str, resource_data: Dict, requester_id: str) -> Dict:
        if resource_type not in self.supported_resources:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported resource type: {resource_type}")

        validation_errors = self._validate_against_profile(resource_type, resource_data)
        if validation_errors:
            return {"outcome": "validation-error", "issues": validation_errors}

        if not self.consent.check_write_authorization(requester_id, resource_type, resource_data):
            raise PermissionError("Write authorization denied by consent policy")

        resource_id = self._generate_resource_id(resource_type, resource_data)
        resource_data["id"] = resource_id
        resource_data["meta"] = {
            "versionId": "1",
            "lastUpdated": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
            "profile": [self.profiles.get(resource_type, "")],
            "source": f"urn:uuid:{requester_id}"
        }

        self.db.insert(resource_type, resource_data)
        self.audit.log_resource_event(
            actor_id=requester_id,
            action="create",
            resource_type=resource_type,
            resource_id=resource_id,
            outcome="success"
        )
        return {"outcome": "created", "resource": resource_data}

    def search_resources(self, resource_type: str, params: Dict, requester_id: str, patient_id: str) -> Dict:
        if not self.consent.check_read_authorization(requester_id, patient_id, resource_type):
            raise PermissionError("Read authorization denied by consent policy")

        results = self.db.search(resource_type, params)
        filtered = self.consent.apply_data_minimization(results, patient_id, requester_id)

        self.audit.log_resource_event(
            actor_id=requester_id,
            action="search",
            resource_type=resource_type,
            patient_id=patient_id,
            outcome="success",
            result_count=len(filtered)
        )
        return {
            "resourceType": "Bundle",
            "type": "searchset",
            "total": len(filtered),
            "entry": [{"resource": r} for r in filtered]
        }

    def _validate_against_profile(self, resource_type: str, data: Dict) -> List[Dict]:
        errors = []
        required_fields = {
            "Patient": ["identifier", "name", "gender", "birthDate"],
            "Observation": ["status", "code", "subject"],
            "Condition": ["clinicalStatus", "verificationStatus", "code", "subject"],
        }
        for field in required_fields.get(resource_type, []):
            if field not in data:
                errors.append({
                    "severity": "error",
                    "code": "required",
                    "details": f"Missing required field: {field}",
                    "expression": [field]
                })
        return errors

    def _generate_resource_id(self, resource_type: str, data: Dict) -> str:
        content_hash = hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()
        ).hexdigest()[:12]
        return f"{resource_type}-{content_hash}"

class ConsentEngine:
    def __init__(self, consent_store):
        self.store = consent_store

    def check_read_authorization(self, requester_id: str, patient_id: str, resource_type: str) -> bool:
        consent = self.store.get_active_consent(patient_id)
        if not consent:
            return False
        return resource_type in consent.get("permittedResources", [])

    def check_write_authorization(self, requester_id: str, resource_type: str, data: Dict) -> bool:
        return True

    def apply_data_minimization(self, results: List[Dict], patient_id: str, requester_id: str) -> List[Dict]:
        consent = self.store.get_active_consent(patient_id)
        if not consent:
            return []
        restricted_fields = consent.get("restrictedFields", [])
        filtered = []
        for result in results:
            for field in restricted_fields:
                if field in result:
                    result[field] = "[REDACTED]"
            filtered.append(result)
        return filtered
}

# AICL Example: Telemedicine Platform
# Comprehensive telemedicine platform with video consultations, scheduling, prescriptions, remote monitoring, and insurance verification

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Build a secure, scalable telemedicine platform that enables high-quality virtual healthcare delivery through video consultations, intelligent scheduling, e-prescribing, remote patient monitoring, and automated insurance verification while ensuring regulatory compliance across all operating jurisdictions.

Constraint: Platform must comply with state-specific telehealth parity laws and prescribing regulations across all operating jurisdictions.

Constraint: Video consultations must support end-to-end encryption with HIPAA-compliant WebRTC infrastructure and minimum 720p resolution.

Constraint: Remote monitoring data must be processed within 30 seconds of receipt for critical value detection and alerting.

Constraint: System must support multilingual consultations with real-time translation for at least 12 languages.

Risk: Video connection failure during active consultation could disrupt patient care and clinical assessment.
Recovery: Implement automatic reconnection with session state preservation; provide PSTN audio fallback within 5 seconds of video loss; maintain consultation transcript buffer for seamless resumption; notify both parties of reconnection in progress.

Risk: Misdiagnosis due to limited physical examination capability in virtual setting could harm patients and create liability.
Recovery: Deploy AI-assisted visual examination tools with image enhancement; mandate structured virtual examination protocols by specialty; require in-person follow-up scheduling for cases exceeding virtual assessment confidence threshold; document virtual examination limitations in encounter notes.

Risk: E-prescribing errors from delayed or mismatched prescriptions could result in patient harm.
Recovery: Implement real-time prescription verification against active medication list and allergy profile; require pharmacist confirmation before dispensing controlled substances; deploy NCPDP SCRIPT v2017 standard with mandatory two-factor prescriber authentication; maintain 72-hour prescription audit trail.

Risk: Insurance verification failures could lead to unexpected patient costs and billing disputes.
Recovery: Cache insurance eligibility results with 24-hour TTL; implement batch pre-verification 48 hours before scheduled appointments; provide real-time cost estimation to patients before consultation; establish financial assistance workflow for verification failures.

Risk: Remote monitoring device data inaccuracy could trigger false alerts or miss critical deterioration.
Recovery: Implement multi-point data validation against clinical plausibility ranges; cross-reference with patient baseline and recent trends; require clinical confirmation before acting on single anomalous reading; calibrate device confidence scores based on signal quality metrics.

Risk: Cross-jurisdictional licensing violations could expose providers to disciplinary action.
Recovery: Maintain real-time provider license verification database by jurisdiction; block appointment scheduling in states where provider lacks active license; generate monthly license expiration reports; implement automatic encounter routing to licensed providers only.

Layer: TelemedicinePlatform
    SubLayer: ConsultationServices
        # Video/audio sessions, screen sharing, examination tools

    SubLayer: PrescriptionServices

    SubLayer: InsuranceVerification

Validation: Video session encryption verified before consultation start with automatic session termination on encryption failure.
Validation: Provider active license status validated against jurisdiction of patient location before consultation.
Validation: E-prescription validated against NCPDP SCRIPT standard and PDMP requirements before transmission.
Validation: Remote monitoring data validated against device calibration profile and clinical plausibility ranges.
Validation: Insurance eligibility confirmed with payer within 24 hours of scheduled appointment.
Validation: Patient identity verified through multi-factor authentication before accessing health information.

# === LEVEL 4: CONDITIONS ===

Condition: CriticalMonitoringAlert
    When remote monitoring reading exceeds patient-specific critical threshold with quality indicator above 0.8
    Then escalate alert to assigned provider within 2 minutes; send SMS and push notification to patient; if no provider acknowledgment within 10 minutes, escalate to covering provider and on-call team; log alert in patient monitoring record; recommend patient seek immediate care if life-threatening

Condition: ProviderLicenseInvalid
    When provider license verification fails for patient's jurisdiction at time of scheduling or consultation
    Then prevent appointment booking in unlicensed jurisdiction; display license status to provider with renewal instructions; route patient to available licensed provider; log license validation failure for compliance audit; notify credentialing team of license issue

Condition: InsuranceCoverageDenied
    When insurance verification returns denial for telehealth services for patient's location and service type
    Then notify patient of coverage denial with estimated self-pay cost; offer financial assistance program information; provide option to proceed with self-pay or reschedule; log denial for payer contract review; suggest alternative covered service types if available

Condition: VideoQualityDegradation
    When video consultation connection quality drops below minimum threshold (720p, 30fps) for more than 30 seconds
    Then automatically attempt quality recovery through codec adjustment; offer PSTN audio fallback to maintain consultation continuity; log quality degradation event with diagnostic data; flag consultation for quality review if clinical assessment may be impacted; schedule technical follow-up if persistent

Condition: PrescriptionInteractionWarning
    When e-prescription screening detects moderate or severe drug interaction with active medications
    Then display interaction details to prescriber with clinical evidence; require documented clinical rationale for proceeding; offer alternative medication suggestions; if severe interaction, require peer consultation before transmission; log interaction override for pharmacy verification

Condition: DeviceDataAnomaly
    When remote monitoring device transmits data that fails calibration validation or is physiologically implausible
    Then flag reading as unreliable with quality indicator below threshold; request patient to recalibrate device; exclude anomalous reading from trend analysis; notify clinical team of potential device malfunction; schedule device replacement if pattern persists across 3 consecutive readings

# === LEVEL 5: EVENTS ===

Event: ConsultationStarted
    On video consultation session successfully established between patient and provider
    Action: Begin consultation timer; activate clinical documentation tools; start recording if consented; notify scheduling system of session start; load patient monitoring data dashboard; enable e-prescribing capability for session; set consultation status to in-progress

Event: MonitoringCriticalValue
    On remote monitoring reading processed and classified as critical
    Action: Generate high-priority alert to assigned provider; send patient notification with guidance; activate emergency protocol if life-threatening value; log critical event in monitoring record; update care plan with alert occurrence; trigger quality review for repeated critical values

Event: PrescriptionTransmitted
    On e-prescription successfully transmitted to pharmacy
    Action: Confirm delivery to patient via portal notification; update patient medication list; record transmission in PDMP for controlled substances; schedule medication adherence follow-up; link prescription to consultation encounter; generate pharmacy pickup reminder

Event: InsuranceVerificationExpired
    On cached insurance verification result exceeds TTL and becomes stale
    Action: Automatically initiate re-verification with payer; flag affected upcoming appointments; notify patient if verification fails; hold appointment confirmation until updated verification received; update financial responsibility estimate

Event: ConsultationCompleted
    On provider ends consultation session and initiates documentation
    Action: Generate after-visit summary from consultation data; submit billing claim with appropriate telehealth modifiers; schedule follow-up if indicated; update patient encounter record; trigger patient satisfaction survey; release provider slot for next patient

Event: DeviceDisconnected
    On remote monitoring device loses connectivity for more than configured threshold
    Action: Attempt automatic device re-pairing; notify patient of device disconnection; alert clinical team if critical monitoring device; log disconnection event with duration; switch to manual patient-reported data collection if extended outage; schedule technical support contact

# === LEVEL 6: CONCURRENCY ===

Parallel:
    Video stream processing and clinical documentation tools running concurrently during consultation
    Remote monitoring data ingestion and alert evaluation executing simultaneously across all active patients
    Insurance verification and appointment scheduling running concurrently for new booking requests
    E-prescription validation and PDMP checking executing in parallel for controlled substance orders
    Provider schedule synchronization and patient notification dispatching concurrently on schedule changes
    Consultation recording transcription and clinical NLP analysis running in parallel post-consultation
    Multi-device monitoring aggregation and baseline trend calculation executing concurrently per patient

# === LEVEL 7: OPTIMIZATION ===

Optimize: Video consultation connection quality and reliability
    Priority: Achieve 99.5% successful consultation connections; maintain video latency under 150ms; minimize connection setup time to under 10 seconds; optimize for variable bandwidth conditions

Optimize: Provider utilization and consultation throughput
    Priority: Maximize provider consultation time to 85% of scheduled hours; minimize no-show rate below 10%; optimize scheduling algorithms for provider preferences and patient needs

Optimize: Remote monitoring alert specificity
    Priority: Reduce false positive critical alerts by 40% while maintaining 100% sensitivity for true critical events; achieve positive predictive value above 75% for monitoring alerts

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import hashlib
import json

class TelemedicinePlatform:
    def __init__(self, db, video_service, prescription_gateway, insurance_service, monitoring_engine):
        self.db = db
        self.video = video_service
        self.rx_gateway = prescription_gateway
        self.insurance = insurance_service
        self.monitor = monitoring_engine
        self.license_registry = {}
        self.critical_thresholds = {}

    def initiate_consultation(self, patient_id: str, provider_id: str, consult_type: str, patient_location: Dict) -> Dict:
        state = patient_location.get("state", "")
        if not self._verify_provider_license(provider_id, state):
            return {"error": f"Provider not licensed in {state}", "code": "LICENSE_INVALID"}

        verification = self.insurance.verify_eligibility(
            patient_id=patient_id,
            state=state,
            service_type=consult_type
        )
        if not verification.get("telehealth_covered"):
            return {"error": "Telehealth not covered", "code": "COVERAGE_DENIED", "details": verification}

        session = self.video.create_room(
            provider_id=provider_id,
            patient_id=patient_id,
            encryption_required=True,
            recording_consent=False,
            fallback_audio=True
        )

        consultation = {
            "consultationId": f"CONS-{hashlib.sha256(f'{patient_id}{provider_id}{datetime.now().isoformat()}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]}",
            "patientId": patient_id,
            "providerId": provider_id,
            "consultationType": consult_type,
            "consultationStatus": "SCHEDULED",
            "videoSessionId": session["roomId"],
            "patientLocation": patient_location,
            "scheduledDateTime": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }
        self.db.insert("consultations", consultation)
        return {
            "sessionDetails": consultation,
            "connectionToken": session["patientToken"],
            "preChecklist": self._generate_pre_checklist(consult_type)
        }

    def process_monitoring_reading(self, device_id: str, reading_data: Dict) -> Dict:
        device = self.db.get("devices", device_id)
        if not device:
            return {"error": "Device not found"}

        quality = self._assess_reading_quality(reading_data, device)
        if quality < 0.5:
            return {"status": "UNRELIABLE", "qualityIndicator": quality, "action": "RECALIBRATE"}

        patient_id = device["patientId"]
        baseline = self.monitor.get_patient_baseline(patient_id, reading_data["readingType"])
        deviation = abs(reading_data["value"] - baseline.get("mean", reading_data["value"]))
        std_devs = deviation / max(baseline.get("stdDev", 1), 0.001)

        is_critical = std_devs > self.critical_thresholds.get(reading_data["readingType"], 3.0)

        reading = {
            "readingId": f"MON-{hashlib.sha256(f'{device_id}{datetime.now().isoformat()}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]}",
            "deviceId": device_id,
            "patientId": patient_id,
            "readingType": reading_data["readingType"],
            "value": reading_data["value"],
            "unit": reading_data.get("unit", ""),
            "qualityIndicator": quality,
            "isCritical": is_critical,
            "baselineDeviation": std_devs,
            "readingDateTime": reading_data.get("timestamp", datetime.now().isoformat()),
        }
        self.db.insert("monitoring_readings", reading)

        if is_critical:
            self._trigger_critical_alert(patient_id, reading)

        return {"status": "PROCESSED", "reading": reading, "isCritical": is_critical}

    def submit_e_prescription(self, rx_data: Dict, provider_id: str, patient_id: str) -> Dict:
        interactions = self.rx_gateway.check_interactions(
            patient_id=patient_id,
            new_medication=rx_data["medicationId"]
        )
        severe_interactions = [i for i in interactions if i["severity"] in ["SEVERE", "CONTRAINDICATED"]]
        if severe_interactions:
            return {"status": "INTERACTION_BLOCKED", "interactions": severe_interactions}

        if rx_data.get("controlledSchedule") in ["II", "IIN", "III", "IIIN"]:
            pdmp_result = self.rx_gateway.query_pdmp(provider_id, patient_id)
            if not pdmp_result.get("cleared"):
                return {"status": "PDMP_FLAGGED", "details": pdmp_result}

        transmission = self.rx_gateway.transmit(
            prescription=rx_data,
            pharmacy_id=rx_data["pharmacyId"],
            provider_id=provider_id
        )
        return {"status": "TRANSMITTED", "prescriptionId": transmission["rxId"], "confirmation": transmission}

    def _verify_provider_license(self, provider_id: str, state: str) -> bool:
        license_info = self.license_registry.get(provider_id, {})
        state_licenses = license_info.get("activeLicenses", [])
        return any(lic["state"] == state and lic["status"] == "ACTIVE" for lic in state_licenses)

    def _assess_reading_quality(self, reading: Dict, device: Dict) -> float:
        if not device.get("lastCalibrationDate"):
            return 0.3
        cal_days = (datetime.now() - datetime.fromisoformat(device["lastCalibrationDate"])).days
        if cal_days > 90:
            return 0.4
        battery = device.get("batteryLevel", 0)
        if battery < 10:
            return 0.3
        return min(1.0, 0.5 + 0.5 * max(0, 1 - cal_days / 180))

    def _trigger_critical_alert(self, patient_id: str, reading: Dict):
        provider = self.monitor.get_assigned_provider(patient_id)
        self.db.insert("critical_alerts", {
            "patientId": patient_id,
            "providerId": provider,
            "readingId": reading["readingId"],
            "alertType": "CRITICAL_MONITORING",
            "createdDateTime": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "status": "PENDING_ACKNOWLEDGMENT"
        })

    def _generate_pre_checklist(self, consult_type: str) -> List[str]:
        base = ["Verify audio and video", "Confirm identity", "Review medical history"]
        type_specific = {
            "NEW_PATIENT": ["Complete intake form", "Upload insurance card", "Verify pharmacy"],
            "FOLLOW_UP": ["Update medication list", "Prepare symptom diary", "Have monitoring device ready"],
            "URGENT_CARE": ["Describe chief complaint", "Take temperature if possible", "Note symptom duration"],
        }
        return base + type_specific.get(consult_type, [])
}

# AICL Example: Clinical Trial Management System
# Full lifecycle clinical trial management including protocol design, patient enrollment, data capture, adverse events, and regulatory compliance

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Provide a comprehensive clinical trial management platform that supports end-to-end trial lifecycle from protocol design through regulatory submission, ensuring patient safety, data integrity, regulatory compliance (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH-GCP), and efficient site and investigator management.

Constraint: System must comply with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records and signatures requirements including audit trails, access controls, and data integrity verification.

Constraint: All clinical data capture must conform to CDISC ODM and SDTM standards for regulatory submission readiness.

Constraint: Adverse event reporting must comply with MedDRA coding and support expedited safety reporting per ICH E2A guidelines within 24-hour regulatory timelines.

Constraint: Patient privacy must be maintained through de-identification per HIPAA Safe Harbor and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for all research data.

Risk: Data integrity compromise in clinical trial database could invalidate study results and delay regulatory submission.
Recovery: Implement 21 CFR Part 11 compliant audit trail with reason-for-change documentation; deploy continuous data integrity monitoring with checksum verification; activate point-in-time database restore capability; notify sponsor and regulatory team of integrity event within 2 hours; initiate independent data audit.

Risk: Missed serious adverse event reporting deadline could result in regulatory action and patient safety risk.
Recovery: Implement automated SAE detection and routing with timer-based escalation; maintain 24/7 safety team on-call rotation; deploy redundant notification channels including secure email, SMS, and direct phone; generate pre-populated MedWatch and CIOMS forms for rapid submission; escalate to Chief Medical Officer if reporting SLA is at risk.

Risk: Patient enrollment shortfall could extend trial timelines and increase costs significantly.
Recovery: Deploy predictive enrollment modeling with real-time site performance tracking; activate patient recruitment campaigns with digital outreach; implement protocol amendment fast-track for eligibility expansion; engage backup sites with pre-qualified investigator teams; adjust randomization strategy for remaining enrollment targets.

Risk: Protocol deviation at study site could compromise data quality and patient safety.
Recovery: Implement real-time protocol deviation detection with automated alerts; trigger immediate site contact and corrective action plan; escalate repeated deviations to sponsor monitoring team; generate deviation reports for IRB notification; assess impact on data integrity and statistical validity.

Risk: Unblinding of treatment assignment could compromise trial integrity and necessitate protocol modification.
Recovery: Implement multi-layer blinding controls with separate unblinding authorization; maintain emergency unblinding with 24-hour sponsor approval workflow; document all unblinding events with reason and authorization; assess impact on ongoing trial integrity; notify DSMB and regulatory authority if study-wide unblinding occurs.

Risk: Regulatory inspection finding of non-compliance could result in warning letter or clinical hold.
Recovery: Maintain continuous compliance monitoring dashboard; deploy automated inspection-readiness checks; maintain TMF completeness index above 95%; generate corrective and preventive action plans within 48 hours of finding notification; engage regulatory affairs consultants for response preparation.

Layer: ClinicalTrialManagement
    SubLayer: ProtocolDesign
        # Study design, endpoints, eligibility criteria, statistical analysis plan

        Generate inspection readiness assessment with gap analysis
