# === LEVEL 4: CONDITIONS ===

Condition: SeriousAdverseEventDetected
    When adverse event meets one or more seriousness criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, medically important)
    Then initiate expedited safety reporting workflow within 24 hours; notify sponsor safety team and DSMB immediately; generate CIOMS form for regulatory submission within 7 calendar days; assess unblinding necessity with independent safety review; implement site-level safety measures; update Investigator's Brochure if new safety signal

Condition: EnrollmentRateBelowTarget

    Then trigger enrollment remediation plan; analyze enrollment barriers by site and region; activate patient recruitment campaign with digital channels; evaluate eligibility criteria relaxation through protocol amendment; engage high-performing sites for enrollment acceleration; report enrollment risk to steering committee

    Adapt: Real-time data entry guidance and CRF design optimization
    Based: Historical query patterns by field, common data entry errors, and edit check effectiveness analysis

# === LEVEL 9: SECURITY ===

Security:
    Encrypt: All clinical data at rest using AES-256 with column-level encryption for subject-identifying fields
    Encrypt: All data transmissions between sites and central systems using TLS 1.3 with mutual authentication
    Encrypt: Electronic signatures using FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules per 21 CFR Part 11
    Protect: Subject identity through de-identification with mapping stored in separate encrypted vault

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class ClinicalTrialManagementSystem:
    def __init__(self, db, safety_db, randomization_service, edc_service, regulatory_gateway):
        self.db = db
        self.safety = safety_db
        self.randomizer = randomization_service
        self.edc = edc_service
        self.regulatory = regulatory_gateway
        self.meddra_version = "26.1"
        self.reporting_timelines = {
            "DEATH": timedelta(hours=24),
            "LIFE_THREATENING": timedelta(hours=24),
            "HOSPITALIZATION": timedelta(days=7),
            "DISABILITY": timedelta(days=7),
            "CONGENITAL_ANOMALY": timedelta(days=7),
        }

    def enroll_subject(self, subject_data: Dict, study_id: str, site_id: str, screening_results: Dict) -> Dict:
        eligibility = self._evaluate_eligibility(subject_data, screening_results, study_id)
        if not eligibility["meets_criteria"]:
            return {"status": "SCREEN_FAIL", "reasons": eligibility["failed_criteria"]}

        duplicate_check = self._check_duplicate_enrollment(subject_data, study_id)
        if duplicate_check["is_duplicate"]:
            return {"status": "DUPLICATE_DETECTED", "details": duplicate_check}

        randomization = self.randomizer.assign(
            study_id=study_id,
            site_id=site_id,
            stratification_factors=screening_results.get("stratification", {}),
            unblinded=False
        )

        subject = {
            "subjectId": f"SUBJ-{site_id}-{random.randint(1000, 9999)}",
            "studyId": study_id,
            "siteId": site_id,
            "screeningNumber": screening_results["screeningNumber"],
            "randomizationNumber": randomization["randomization_number"],
            "treatmentArm": randomization["treatment_arm"],
            "enrollmentDate": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "status": "ENROLLED",
            "informedConsentDate": subject_data["consentDate"],
            "icfVersion": subject_data["icfVersion"],
            "visitHistory": [],
            "adverseEvents": [],
            "protocolDeviations": [],
        }
        self.db.insert("subjects", subject)
        visit_schedule = self._generate_visit_schedule(study_id, subject["enrollmentDate"])
        return {"status": "ENROLLED", "subject": subject, "visitSchedule": visit_schedule}

    def process_adverse_event(self, ae_data: Dict, subject_id: str, study_id: str, reporter_id: str) -> Dict:
        meddra_coding = self.safety.code_meddra(ae_data["eventTerm"], self.meddra_version)
        seriousness = self._assess_seriouness(ae_data)
        causality = self._assess_causality(ae_data, study_id)

        ae_record = {
            "aeId": f"AE-{hashlib.sha256(f'{subject_id}{datetime.now().isoformat()}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}",
            "subjectId": subject_id,
            "studyId": study_id,
            "eventTerm": ae_data["eventTerm"],
            "meddraCode": meddra_coding["code"],
            "meddraPT": meddra_coding["preferredTerm"],
            "severity": ae_data.get("severity", "UNKNOWN"),
            "seriousness": seriousness["category"],
            "startDate": ae_data.get("startDate"),
            "outcome": ae_data.get("outcome", "ONGOING"),
            "causalityAssessment": causality["assessment"],
            "relatedToStudyDrug": causality["related"],
            "saeCriteria": seriousness["met_criteria"],
            "reportingDeadline": None,
            "narrative": ae_data.get("narrative", ""),
        }

        if seriousness["is_serious"]:
            deadline = datetime.now() + self.reporting_timelines.get(
                seriousness["met_criteria"][0] if seriousness["met_criteria"] else "HOSPITALIZATION",
                timedelta(days=7)
            )
            ae_record["reportingDeadline"] = deadline.isoformat()
            self.safety.initiate_expedited_reporting(ae_record, study_id)

        self.db.insert("adverse_events", ae_record)
        return {
            "aeRecord": ae_record,
            "meddraCoding": meddra_coding,
            "isSAE": seriousness["is_serious"],
            "reportingRequired": seriousness["is_serious"],
        }

    def _evaluate_eligibility(self, subject_data: Dict, screening: Dict, study_id: str) -> Dict:
        protocol = self.db.get("protocols", study_id)
        failed = []
        for criterion in protocol.get("inclusionCriteria", []):
            if not self._check_criterion(subject_data, screening, criterion):
                failed.append(f"Inclusion not met: {criterion['description']}")
        for criterion in protocol.get("exclusionCriteria", []):
            if self._check_criterion(subject_data, screening, criterion):
                failed.append(f"Exclusion met: {criterion['description']}")
        return {"meets_criteria": len(failed) == 0, "failed_criteria": failed}

    def _assess_seriouness(self, ae_data: Dict) -> Dict:
        criteria_met = []
        if ae_data.get("resultedInDeath"):
            criteria_met.append("DEATH")
        if ae_data.get("lifeThreatening"):
            criteria_met.append("LIFE_THREATENING")
        if ae_data.get("requiredHospitalization"):
            criteria_met.append("HOSPITALIZATION")
        if ae_data.get("causedDisability"):
            criteria_met.append("DISABILITY")
        if ae_data.get("congenitalAnomaly"):
            criteria_met.append("CONGENITAL_ANOMALY")
        return {
            "is_serious": len(criteria_met) > 0,
            "category": "SERIOUS" if criteria_met else "NON_SERIOUS",
            "met_criteria": criteria_met,
        }

    def _assess_causality(self, ae_data: Dict, study_id: str) -> Dict:
        related = ae_data.get("causality", "UNRELATED") in ["POSSIBLY_RELATED", "PROBABLY_RELATED", "DEFINITELY_RELATED"]
        return {
            "assessment": ae_data.get("causality", "UNRELATED"),
            "related": related,
        }

    def _check_duplicate_enrollment(self, subject_data: Dict, study_id: str) -> Dict:
        return {"is_duplicate": False}

    def _generate_visit_schedule(self, study_id: str, enrollment_date: str) -> List[Dict]:
        protocol = self.db.get("protocols", study_id)
        schedule = []
        base_date = datetime.fromisoformat(enrollment_date)
        for visit in protocol.get("visitSchedule", []):
            visit_date = base_date + timedelta(days=visit.get("dayOffset", 0))
            schedule.append({
                "visitName": visit["name"],
                "plannedDate": visit_date.isoformat(),
                "window": visit.get("windowDays", 3),
            })
        return schedule
}

# AICL Example: Learning Management System
# Full-featured LMS with course management, assessments, progress tracking, certificates, and SCORM compliance

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Build a scalable learning management system that delivers personalized education experiences through course management, adaptive assessments, comprehensive progress tracking, verifiable digital certificates, SCORM/xAPI compliance, and social learning features while supporting institutional and corporate training workflows.

Constraint: System must support SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, and xAPI (Tin Can) standards for content interoperability.

Constraint: Assessment engine must support item banking with psychometric analysis including difficulty, discrimination, and distractor analysis.

Constraint: Certificate system must provide cryptographically verifiable digital credentials compliant with Open Badges 3.0 specification.

Constraint: Platform must support multi-tenancy with complete data isolation between organizational accounts.

Risk: SCORM content compatibility failures could prevent course delivery and disrupt learning schedules.
Recovery: Implement SCORM content validation pipeline with pre-upload testing; maintain fallback content rendering engine; auto-convert incompatible content with notification to course author; provide offline SCORM player for disconnected learning; log compatibility issues for vendor follow-up.

Risk: Assessment security breach could compromise exam integrity and credential value.
Recovery: Deploy multi-layer anti-cheat system with browser lockdown and behavior analysis; invalidate compromised assessment items immediately; generate replacement items from question bank; notify affected learners and instructors; conduct forensic analysis to determine breach scope.

Risk: Certificate fraud through credential forgery could damage institutional reputation.
Recovery: Issue certificates with blockchain-anchored cryptographic verification; maintain public verification portal; implement certificate revocation registry; deploy watermarking and unique QR codes; alert institution of verification attempts against revoked certificates.

Risk: Data loss of learner progress could impact completion tracking and compliance reporting.
Recovery: Implement real-time progress data replication across geographic zones; maintain point-in-time snapshots every 15 minutes; deploy automatic failover with zero data loss tolerance; reconstruct progress from xAPI statement store if primary store fails.

Risk: Platform performance degradation during peak enrollment could cause poor learning experience.
Recovery: Deploy auto-scaling infrastructure with 200% burst capacity; implement CDN-based content delivery for media-heavy courses; activate read replicas for progress queries during peak periods; implement graceful degradation for non-critical features.

Risk: Accessibility compliance gaps could create legal liability and exclude learners with disabilities.
Recovery: Implement automated WCAG 2.1 AA scanning on all published content; block publication of non-compliant content with remediation guidance; provide accessibility audit dashboard for content creators; maintain assistive technology compatibility testing lab.

Layer: LearningManagementSystem
    SubLayer: CourseManagement
        # Course creation, curriculum design, content authoring, versioning
    SubLayer: AssessmentEngine
        # Question banking, exam delivery, psychometrics, anti-cheat
    SubLayer: ProgressTracking
        # Completion tracking, analytics, reporting, competency mapping
    SubLayer: CredentialManagement
        # Certificate generation, verification, Open Badges, revocation
    SubLayer: ContentInteroperability
        # SCORM runtime, xAPI LRS, content packaging, import/export
    SubLayer: SocialLearning
        # Discussions, peer review, collaboration, mentoring

Validation: SCORM package validated against ADL conformance test suite before course publication.
Validation: Assessment items validated against psychometric quality thresholds (difficulty 0.3-0.7, discrimination > 0.25).
Validation: Learner progress totals validated against SCORM and xAPI statement records on every completion event.
Validation: Certificate digital signatures verified against institutional signing key before issuance.
Validation: Course accessibility validated against WCAG 2.1 AA automated scan with zero critical violations.
Validation: Multi-tenant data isolation validated with query-level tenant filtering on every database operation.
Validation: Assessment randomization verified for statistical equivalence across generated test forms.

# === LEVEL 3: BEHAVIORS ===

Behavior CreateCourse
    Input: courseData: dict, contentPackage: dict, instructorIds: list, organizationId: string
    Output: courseRecord: dict, scormValidation: dict, publicationStatus: string
    Action:
        Parse and validate SCORM/xAPI content package structure
        Run content through accessibility validation pipeline
        Extract learning objectives and map to competency framework
        Configure course settings for enrollment and scheduling
        Assign course version number with change tracking
        Validate all assessment links and prerequisite chains
        Publish course to catalog or save as draft per instructor preference

Behavior DeliverAssessment
    Input: assessmentId: string, learnerId: string, attemptNumber: integer, securityContext: dict
    Output: assessmentForm: dict, timerToken: string, proctoringSession: dict
    Action:
        Generate unique assessment form using randomization strategy
        Apply security profile with browser lockdown if configured
        Initialize proctoring session with identity verification
        Calculate and enforce time limit with server-side timer
        Record assessment start event in xAPI statement store
        Configure question navigation and submission rules
        Enable auto-save at configurable intervals

Behavior RecordProgress
    Input: learnerId: string, courseId: string, progressEvent: dict, scormData: dict
    Output: updatedProgress: dict, completionCheck: dict, xapiStatements: list
    Action:
        Process SCORM or xAPI progress data from content runtime
        Update lesson completion status and time tracking
        Calculate cumulative completion percentage
        Check against course completion criteria threshold
        Generate xAPI statements for learning record store
        Trigger completion workflow if threshold reached
        Update competency map based on demonstrated skills

Behavior IssueCertificate
    Input: learnerId: string, courseId: string, completionRecord: dict, templateId: string
    Output: certificate: dict, verificationData: dict, badgeAssertion: dict
    Action:
        Verify course completion meets all certificate criteria
        Generate unique certificate with cryptographic signing
        Anchor certificate hash to blockchain for tamper-proof verification
        Create Open Badges 3.0 compliant badge assertion
        Send certificate notification to learner via email and portal
        Publish to learner's public credential portfolio if opted-in
        Register certificate in verification directory

Behavior AnalyzeAssessmentPsychometrics
    Input: assessmentId: string, responseDataset: list, minimumSampleSize: integer
    Output: psychometricReport: dict, itemAnalysis: list, flaggedItems: list
    Action:
        Calculate difficulty index for each item (proportion correct)
        Compute discrimination index (point-biserial correlation)
        Analyze distractor effectiveness for multiple-choice items
        Assess internal consistency reliability (Cronbach's alpha)
        Identify items falling outside quality thresholds
        Generate item characteristic curves for flagged items
        Recommend items for revision or retirement from active pool

Behavior ManageDiscussionForum
    Input: courseId: string, discussionId: string, postId: string, action: string, moderatorId: string
    Output: updatedForum: dict, moderationLog: dict, notificationResult: dict
    Action:
        Validate post content against community guidelines
        Apply content moderation with automated toxicity screening
        Process instructor actions (pin, feature, lock, delete)
        Route posts requiring human moderator review
        Send notifications to subscribed discussion participants
        Update discussion thread statistics and rankings
        Generate weekly discussion summary for instructor review

Behavior GenerateLearningAnalytics
    Input: organizationId: string, dateRange: dict, metricCategories: list, granularity: string
    Output: analyticsReport: dict, trendData: dict, predictions: dict, exportFormats: list
    Action:
        Aggregate learner engagement metrics across courses and programs
        Calculate completion rates, time-to-completion, and dropout patterns
        Generate competency attainment heat maps by course and program
        Apply predictive models for at-risk learner identification
        Compare performance across cohorts and demographic segments
        Export data in standard formats for institutional reporting
        Generate visualizations for executive dashboards

# === LEVEL 4: CONDITIONS ===

Condition: AtRiskLearnerDetected
    When learner engagement drops below 30% of expected activity for 7 consecutive days or assessment score falls below 50% on two consecutive attempts
    Then trigger early intervention workflow; notify assigned advisor or instructor; generate personalized remediation recommendations; offer office hours scheduling; adjust learning path pace if self-paced; log intervention for outcomes tracking

Condition: AssessmentSecurityViolation
    When proctoring system detects prohibited behavior (tab switching, multiple faces, unauthorized materials) during secured assessment
    Then flag assessment attempt for security review; pause assessment with warning; notify instructor and academic integrity office; capture forensic evidence including screenshots; require student acknowledgment before continuing; generate incident report with evidence package

Condition: CertificateEligibilityAchieved
    When learner meets all completion criteria including required assessments, minimum scores, and time requirements
    Then trigger certificate issuance workflow; generate certificate with institutional branding and cryptographic signing; issue Open Badges compliant digital badge; notify learner of certificate availability; update learner transcript and achievement record; post to social media if learner opts in

Condition: CourseAccessibilityViolation
    When automated WCAG 2.1 AA scan detects critical accessibility errors in published course content
    Then block content from new learner access; notify course author with specific violations and remediation steps; set 72-hour deadline for critical fixes; provide accessibility remediation assistance tools; escalate to compliance team if unresolved; maintain access for learners with existing progress

Condition: QuestionBankQualityDegradation
    When psychometric analysis reveals items with discrimination below 0.15 or difficulty outside 0.2-0.8 range
    Then flag items for review by assessment committee; remove from active assessment generation; schedule item revision or retirement; replace with calibrated items from reserve pool; notify item author of quality concerns; log item lifecycle change for audit trail

Condition: EnrollmentCapacityReached
    When course enrollment count reaches configured maximum capacity
    Then activate waitlist with automatic queue management; notify prospective learners of waitlist position; offer alternative sections or similar courses; evaluate instructor capacity for section addition; generate capacity planning report; adjust waitlist priority based on prerequisites and urgency

# === LEVEL 5: EVENTS ===

Event: CoursePublished
    On course completes validation and is published to catalog
    Action: Index course in search and discovery; notify waitlisted learners of availability; generate course announcement for enrolled population; update organization course catalog; activate SCORM runtime for learner access; begin enrollment tracking and analytics collection

Event: AssessmentSubmitted
    On learner submits completed assessment for grading
    Action: Calculate raw and scaled scores; apply partial credit rubric if configured; trigger automated grading for objective items; route subjective items to grader queue; record score in learner progress; generate xAPI scored statement; update competency map based on assessment results

Event: CourseCompleted
    On learner achieves all completion criteria for a course
    Action: Update completion status and certificate eligibility; calculate final grade per grading policy; generate course completion xAPI statements; trigger certificate issuance workflow; update learning path progress; send completion notification to learner and organization; request course evaluation feedback

Event: DiscussionReplyPosted
    On new reply posted in course discussion forum
    Action: Notify thread participants of new reply; update discussion activity metrics; apply content moderation rules; check for instructor mention notifications; update learner engagement score; generate discussion participation xAPI statement; update thread ranking for popularity

Event: LearningPathMilestoneAchieved
    On learner completes a designated milestone within a learning path
    Action: Update path progress tracking and visualization; unlock next course in sequence if gated; award milestone badge if configured; notify advisor of progress; adjust remaining path schedule if adaptive; check for path completion; generate milestone xAPI statement

Event: CertificateRevoked
    On certificate revocation initiated due to academic integrity or administrative action
    Action: Update certificate status to revoked in verification directory; remove from learner public portfolio; notify learner of revocation with reason and appeal process; update institutional compliance records; invalidate blockchain verification entry; log revocation event for audit trail

# === LEVEL 6: CONCURRENCY ===

Parallel:
    SCORM content delivery and progress data collection running concurrently for real-time tracking
    Assessment delivery engine and proctoring analysis executing simultaneously during secure exams
    Certificate generation and blockchain anchoring running in parallel for issuance performance
    Learning analytics aggregation and predictive model inference executing concurrently for reporting
    Discussion moderation and notification dispatching running in parallel for forum responsiveness
    Psychometric item analysis and question pool management executing concurrently for assessment quality
    xAPI statement processing and competency map updates running simultaneously across all active learners

# === LEVEL 7: OPTIMIZATION ===

Optimize: Course content delivery speed and reliability
    Priority: Achieve sub-3-second page load for course content; support 10,000 concurrent SCORM sessions; maintain 99.9% content availability through CDN distribution

Optimize: Assessment delivery performance under load
    Priority: Support 5,000 simultaneous assessment sessions; achieve assessment form generation under 2 seconds; eliminate timer drift to below 1 second per hour

Optimize: Learner engagement and completion rates
    Priority: Improve average course completion rate to above 65%; reduce time-to-first-engagement to under 24 hours from enrollment; minimize dropout rate through predictive intervention

Optimize: Certificate issuance and verification speed
    Priority: Generate certificates within 30 seconds of eligibility; achieve verification response under 1 second; process blockchain anchoring within 5 minutes

Optimize: Analytics and reporting query performance
    Priority: Return organization-level analytics within 10 seconds; support real-time dashboards with 30-second refresh; handle 1 million learner records without degradation

# === LEVEL 8: LEARNING ===

Learn: Learner dropout prediction
    Goal: Predict course dropout probability with 80% accuracy using engagement patterns, assessment performance, and demographic features
    Adapt: Intervention timing and personalization of retention outreach
    Based: Engagement velocity trends, assessment score trajectories, login frequency patterns, and peer comparison data

Learn: Adaptive assessment difficulty
    Goal: Optimize assessment difficulty in real-time to achieve target information gain per item with 75% accuracy
    Adapt: Computerized adaptive testing item selection algorithm
    Based: Current ability estimate, item information function, and response pattern analysis

Learn: Content effectiveness scoring
    Goal: Predict learning objective achievement rate from content features with 70% accuracy
    Adapt: Course content recommendations and learning path sequencing
    Based: Content interaction patterns, assessment outcome correlations, and learning style indicators

Learn: Optimal study schedule generation
    Goal: Generate personalized study schedules that improve retention by 25% compared to fixed schedules
    Adapt: Spaced repetition intervals and content review recommendations
    Based: Forgetting curve parameters, individual retention rates, and learning session patterns

Learn: Peer learning group formation
    Goal: Form optimal study groups that improve collaborative learning outcomes by 20% with 85% group satisfaction
    Adapt: Discussion group assignments and collaborative project team formation
    Based: Complementary skill profiles, learning pace compatibility, and communication style matching

# === LEVEL 9: SECURITY ===

Security:
    Encrypt: All learner personal data at rest using AES-256 with tenant-specific key encryption
    Encrypt: Assessment content in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest with field-level encryption for item stems and answers
    Encrypt: Certificate signing keys using HSM-backed key management with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 compliance
    Protect: Assessment items with access-controlled storage and watermarking for leakage traceability
    Protect: Learner progress data with role-based visibility controls and organizational isolation
    Protect: Certificate verification endpoints with rate limiting and request signing to prevent enumeration
    Protect: Proctoring data with encrypted storage and restricted access limited to authorized integrity officers
    Protect: API endpoints with OAuth 2.0 scoped tokens and multi-tenant request validation
    Protect: xAPI statement store with immutable append-only architecture and integrity verification
    Protect: Discussion forums with content moderation pipeline and PII redaction for learner protection

# === LEVEL 10: NATIVE ===

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import hashlib
import json
import random

class LearningManagementSystem:
    def __init__(self, db, scorm_runtime, xapi_store, certificate_service, analytics_engine):
        self.db = db
        self.scorm = scorm_runtime
        self.xapi = xapi_store
        self.certs = certificate_service
        self.analytics = analytics_engine
        self.psychometric_thresholds = {
            "difficulty_min": 0.2, "difficulty_max": 0.8,
            "discrimination_min": 0.15,
            "reliability_min": 0.70,
        }

    def deliver_assessment(self, assessment_id: str, learner_id: str, attempt: int, security: Dict) -> Dict:
        assessment = self.db.get("assessments", assessment_id)
        if attempt > assessment.get("maxAttempts", 3):
            return {"error": "Maximum attempts exceeded"}

        pool = self.db.get("question_pools", assessment["questionPoolId"])
        items = self._select_items(pool, assessment["randomizationStrategy"], assessment["totalQuestions"])

        form = {
            "formId": f"FORM-{assessment_id}-{learner_id}-{attempt}",
            "assessmentId": assessment_id,
            "learnerId": learner_id,
            "attempt": attempt,
            "items": items,
            "timeLimit": assessment["timeLimitMinutes"],
            "securityProfile": assessment["securityProfile"],
        }

        self.xapi.record_statement({
            "actor": {"mbox": f"mailto:{learner_id}@lms.local"},
            "verb": {"id": "http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/launched", "display": {"en-US": "launched"}},
            "object": {"id": f"urn:assessment:{assessment_id}", "definition": {"name": {"en-US": assessment["title"]}}},
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        })

        return {"form": form, "timerToken": hashlib.sha256(f"{form['formId']}{datetime.now().isoformat()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}

    def record_progress(self, learner_id: str, course_id: str, event: Dict, scorm_data: Dict) -> Dict:
        progress = self.db.get_or_create("progress", {"learnerId": learner_id, "courseId": course_id})
        if scorm_data:
            progress["completionPercentage"] = max(
                progress.get("completionPercentage", 0),
                scorm_data.get("cmi.core.lesson_status", "") == "completed" and 100 or scorm_data.get("cmi.core.score.raw", 0)
            )
            progress["totalTimeSpent"] = progress.get("totalTimeSpent", 0) + scorm_data.get("session_time_seconds", 0)

        progress["lastAccessDate"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        lesson_id = event.get("lessonId")
        if lesson_id and lesson_id not in progress.get("lessonsCompleted", []):
            completed = progress.get("lessonsCompleted", [])
            completed.append(lesson_id)
            progress["lessonsCompleted"] = completed

        self.xapi.record_statement({
            "actor": {"mbox": f"mailto:{learner_id}@lms.local"},
            "verb": {"id": event.get("verbId", "http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/experienced")},
            "object": {"id": f"urn:course:{course_id}:lesson:{lesson_id}"},
            "result": {"completion": True, "duration": f"PT{event.get('durationSeconds', 0)}S"},
            "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        })

        completion_check = self._check_completion(progress, course_id)
        self.db.update("progress", progress)

        return {"progress": progress, "completionCheck": completion_check}

    def analyze_psychometrics(self, assessment_id: str, min_sample: int = 30) -> Dict:
        responses = self.db.query("assessment_responses", {"assessmentId": assessment_id})
        if len(responses) < min_sample:
            return {"error": f"Insufficient sample size: {len(responses)} < {min_sample}"}

        items = self._get_assessment_items(assessment_id)
        item_analysis = []
        flagged = []

        for item in items:
            item_responses = [r for r in responses if r["itemId"] == item["itemId"]]
            correct = sum(1 for r in item_responses if r["isCorrect"])
            difficulty = correct / len(item_responses) if item_responses else 0

            total_scores = [r["totalScore"] for r in responses]
            item_scores = [1 if r["isCorrect"] else 0 for r in item_responses]
            discrimination = self._point_biserial(item_scores, total_scores)

            analysis = {
                "itemId": item["itemId"],
                "difficultyIndex": difficulty,
                "discriminationIndex": discrimination,
                "responseCount": len(item_responses),
            }

            if difficulty < self.psychometric_thresholds["difficulty_min"] or difficulty > self.psychometric_thresholds["difficulty_max"]:
                flagged.append({"itemId": item["itemId"], "reason": "DIFFICULTY_OUT_OF_RANGE", "value": difficulty})
            if discrimination < self.psychometric_thresholds["discrimination_min"]:
                flagged.append({"itemId": item["itemId"], "reason": "LOW_DISCRIMINATION", "value": discrimination})

            item_analysis.append(analysis)

        total_score_variance = sum((s - sum(total_scores)/len(total_scores))**2 for s in total_scores) / len(total_scores)
        alpha = self._cronbachs_alpha(responses, items)

        return {
            "itemAnalysis": item_analysis,
            "flaggedItems": flagged,
            "reliability": alpha,
            "sampleSize": len(responses),
            "meanScore": sum(total_scores) / len(total_scores),
        }

    def issue_certificate(self, learner_id: str, course_id: str, completion: Dict) -> Dict:
        cert_hash = hashlib.sha256(f"{learner_id}{course_id}{datetime.now().isoformat()}".encode()).hexdigest()
        certificate = {
            "certificateId": f"CERT-{cert_hash[:12]}",
            "learnerId": learner_id,
            "courseId": course_id,
            "issueDate": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "expiryDate": (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=730)).isoformat(),
            "verificationHash": cert_hash,
            "recipientName": completion.get("learnerName", ""),
            "issuingAuthority": completion.get("institution", ""),
        }
        self.certs.issue(certificate)
        return certificate

    def _select_items(self, pool: Dict, strategy: str, count: int) -> List[Dict]:
        items = pool.get("items", [])
        if strategy == "RANDOM":
            return random.sample(items, min(count, len(items)))
        elif strategy == "STRATIFIED":
            easy = [i for i in items if 0.6 < i.get("difficultyIndex", 0.5) <= 0.8]
            medium = [i for i in items if 0.3 < i.get("difficultyIndex", 0.5) <= 0.6]
            hard = [i for i in items if 0.2 <= i.get("difficultyIndex", 0.5) <= 0.3]
            per_tier = count // 3
            return random.sample(easy, min(per_tier, len(easy))) + random.sample(medium, min(per_tier, len(medium))) + random.sample(hard, min(count - 2*per_tier, len(hard)))
        return items[:count]

    def _point_biserial(self, item_scores: List[float], total_scores: List[float]) -> float:
        n = len(item_scores)
        if n < 2:
            return 0.0
        mean_correct = sum(s for s, i in zip(total_scores, item_scores) if i == 1) / max(sum(item_scores), 1)
        mean_incorrect = sum(s for s, i in zip(total_scores, item_scores) if i == 0) / max(n - sum(item_scores), 1)
        std_total = (sum((s - sum(total_scores)/n)**2 for s in total_scores) / n) ** 0.5
        p = sum(item_scores) / n
        if std_total == 0 or p == 0 or p == 1:
            return 0.0
        return (mean_correct - mean_incorrect) / std_total * (p * (1 - p)) ** 0.5

    def _cronbachs_alpha(self, responses: List[Dict], items: List[Dict]) -> float:
        k = len(items)
        if k < 2:
            return 0.0
        item_vars = []
        for item in items:
            scores = [1 if r["itemId"] == item["itemId"] and r["isCorrect"] else 0 for r in responses]
            mean = sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0
            item_vars.append(sum((s - mean)**2 for s in scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0)
        total_scores = [r["totalScore"] for r in responses]
        total_var = sum((s - sum(total_scores)/len(total_scores))**2 for s in total_scores) / len(total_scores) if total_scores else 0
        if total_var == 0:
            return 0.0
        return (k / (k - 1)) * (1 - sum(item_vars) / total_var)

    def _check_completion(self, progress: Dict, course_id: str) -> Dict:
        course = self.db.get("courses", course_id)
        threshold = course.get("completionThreshold", 100) if course else 100
        is_complete = progress.get("completionPercentage", 0) >= threshold
        return {"isComplete": is_complete, "currentProgress": progress.get("completionPercentage", 0), "threshold": threshold}

    def _get_assessment_items(self, assessment_id: str) -> List[Dict]:
        assessment = self.db.get("assessments", assessment_id)
        pool = self.db.get("question_pools", assessment["questionPoolId"])
        return pool.get("items", [])
}

# AICL Example: Online Examination System
# Comprehensive online examination platform with question banking, proctoring, auto-grading, analytics, anti-cheat, and accessibility

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Deliver a secure, accessible, and scalable online examination system that ensures exam integrity through advanced proctoring, supports diverse question types with intelligent auto-grading, provides comprehensive analytics, prevents cheating through multi-layered detection, and guarantees accessibility for all test-takers.

Constraint: System must support WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all examination interfaces including assistive technology compatibility.

Constraint: Proctoring must support both live and AI-assisted modes with human review for all flagged incidents.

Constraint: Anti-cheat system must detect 95% of common cheating methods with false positive rate below 5%.

Constraint: Question bank must support at minimum 50,000 items with sub-second retrieval and statistical equivalence across generated forms.

Risk: Exam content leakage before or during administration could compromise exam validity and require re-administration.
Recovery: Implement content encryption with just-in-time decryption at exam start; deploy unique form generation per test-taker; immediately rotate compromised items; activate investigation protocol with digital forensics; notify affected institutions within 24 hours; prepare alternate exam forms for emergency re-administration.

Risk: AI proctoring false positives could unfairly penalize honest test-takers and damage institutional trust.
Recovery: Implement tiered flagging with confidence scores; require human review before any academic action; provide test-taker appeal process with full evidence review; maintain proctoring accuracy audit dashboard; adjust sensitivity thresholds based on validated outcome data; ensure due process for all flagged incidents.

Risk: Auto-grading errors could produce incorrect scores affecting test-taker outcomes and institutional decisions.
Recovery: Deploy dual-grading pipeline with automated cross-verification; implement confidence scoring for each graded item; flag items below confidence threshold for human review; maintain complete grading audit trail; enable test-taker score challenge within defined window; re-grade affected items upon error detection.

Risk: System outage during active exam could cause test-taker data loss and schedule disruption.
Recovery: Implement client-side auto-save every 30 seconds with local storage; maintain server-side session state replication; deploy automatic session recovery with preserved answers; extend exam timer by outage duration; provide alternative testing windows for affected test-takers; ensure zero-answer-data-loss guarantee.

Risk: Accessibility tool incompatibility could prevent students with disabilities from completing examinations.
Recovery: Maintain assistive technology compatibility testing lab; provide dedicated accessibility support hotline during exams; offer alternative format delivery for incompatible tools; implement fallback accessible interface; train proctors on disability accommodation protocols; ensure exam content works with screen readers, magnifiers, and switch access.

Risk: Scale failures during concurrent high-stakes exams could cause widespread service degradation.
Recovery: Deploy auto-scaling infrastructure with 500% burst capacity; implement priority queue for active exam sessions over administrative functions; activate CDN-based static asset delivery; maintain warm standby database replicas; implement graceful degradation preserving active exam sessions.

Layer: ExaminationSystem
    SubLayer: ExamDelivery
        # Exam scheduling, form generation, timer management, session control
    SubLayer: QuestionBank
        # Item management, psychometrics, form assembly, version control
    SubLayer: ProctoringEngine
        # AI detection, live monitoring, flag management, evidence collection
    SubLayer: GradingEngine
        # Auto-grading, rubric management, score calculation, grade appeals
    SubLayer: AntiCheatSystem
        # Behavior analysis, content protection, similarity detection, forensics
    SubLayer: AccessibilityServices
        # WCAG compliance, accommodation management, AT compatibility, alt formats

Validation: Exam form statistical equivalence validated against blueprint specifications before administration.
Validation: Proctoring AI model accuracy validated against labeled test dataset with >95% sensitivity quarterly.
Validation: Auto-grading results cross-validated against human expert grading for 5% sample on every exam.
Validation: Accessibility compliance verified against WCAG 2.1 AA checklist for every exam template.
Validation: Anti-cheat detection rate validated against known cheating method test suite semi-annually.
Validation: Question bank item parameters calibrated against minimum 100 response sample before item activation.
Validation: Timer accuracy validated against NTP-synchronized clock with drift tolerance below 1 second per hour.

        Assemble form ensuring statistical equivalence and content balance
        Apply accommodation modifications (extended time, alternative format)

    Action:
        Verify test-taker identity with multi-factor authentication
        Initialize proctoring session with configured mode and sensitivity
        Decrypt and render exam form with accessibility-enabled interface
        Start server-side timer with NTP synchronization
        Activate anti-cheat monitoring including browser lockdown
        Configure auto-save interval and connection resilience

    Action:

        Run real-time anti-cheat analysis on response patterns

Behavior AutoGradeExam
    Input: sessionId: string, examId: string, gradingConfig: dict
    Output: scoreReport: dict, itemResults: list, flaggedItems: list, confidenceScores: dict
    Action:
        Retrieve all responses for the completed exam session
        Apply objective item scoring with exact match or partial credit rubric
        Process subjective items using NLP-based rubric matching
        Calculate confidence scores for each graded item
        Flag items with confidence below threshold for human review
        Compute total and section scores with penalty application
        Generate detailed score report with item-level breakdown

Behavior DetectExamIntegrityViolation
    Input: sessionId: string, behaviorData: dict, responsePatterns: dict, environmentData: dict
    Output: integrityReport: dict, flaggedBehaviors: list, riskScore: float, evidencePackage: dict
    Action:
        Analyze response time patterns for anomalous speed or pauses
        Compare response similarity with other test-takers for collusion detection
        Detect screen sharing, tab switching, or unauthorized application use
        Monitor gaze direction and face detection via proctoring feed
        Analyze keystroke dynamics for impersonation detection
        Check for content leakage indicators in response patterns
        Generate evidence package with timestamps and screenshots for flagged incidents

Behavior ManageAccommodations
    Input: testTakerId: string, examId: string, accommodationRequest: dict, documentation: list
    Output: accommodationPlan: dict, modifiedExamConfig: dict, approvalStatus: string
    Action:
        Validate accommodation request against approved documentation
        Apply time extensions per accommodation specifications
        Configure alternative response formats for motor accessibility
        Enable screen reader compatible content delivery
        Set up separate testing environment if required
        Adjust proctoring sensitivity for accommodation-related behaviors
        Generate accommodation compliance report for regulatory audit

Behavior ProduceExamAnalytics
    Input: examId: string, administrationId: string, analysisParameters: dict
    Output: analyticsReport: dict, psychometricSummary: dict, equityAnalysis: dict
    Action:
        Calculate descriptive statistics for score distribution
        Perform item analysis with difficulty and discrimination indices
        Compute exam reliability using internal consistency measures
        Conduct differential item functioning analysis for equity
        Generate score distribution histograms and percentile ranks
        Compare performance across demographic groups for fairness
        Produce comprehensive analytics report for stakeholders

# === LEVEL 4: CONDITIONS ===

Condition: ProctoringIncidentDetected
    When AI proctoring system flags behavior with confidence score above medium threshold (0.6) or live proctor reports concern
    Then create incident record with evidence capture; pause exam only for high-confidence severe incidents (0.85+); notify human reviewer for immediate assessment; continue exam session for medium-confidence flags pending review; alert test-taker with warning for moderate violations; ensure due process documentation for all flagged incidents

Condition: ExamTimeExpired
    When server-side timer reaches zero or accommodated time limit is exhausted
    Then automatically submit all saved responses; disable further answer entry; save final answer snapshot with timestamp; calculate and record time-overage if any grace period; notify test-taker of automatic submission; generate session completion event; prevent any modifications to submitted responses

Condition: AnswerSimilarityThresholdExceeded
    When response pattern analysis detects similarity above statistical threshold between two or more test-takers on same exam form
    Then flag involved test-takers for collusion investigation; preserve complete response and session data; notify academic integrity office with preliminary analysis; expand similarity check across all test-takers on same administration; do not alter scores pending investigation outcome; engage forensic analyst for detailed pattern analysis

Condition: GradingConfidenceLow
    When auto-grading confidence score falls below threshold (0.85 for objective, 0.70 for subjective items)
    Then route item to human grader queue with priority classification; display preliminary score with pending flag to test-taker; apply human grade as final when completed; track auto-grading accuracy for model improvement; escalate if confidence below 0.50 for immediate human review; maintain dual-grading audit trail

Condition: SystemInterruptionDuringExam
    When test-taker connection drops or system error occurs during active exam session
    Then preserve all submitted answers in client-side storage; pause server-side timer immediately; attempt automatic reconnection with session state restoration; upon reconnection, restore exact timer state and current question; if reconnection fails within 10 minutes, activate alternative testing arrangement; log interruption event for timer adjustment calculation

Condition: AccessibilityAccommodationRequired
    When test-taker profile indicates required accommodation not properly configured in exam session
    Then halt exam start until accommodation is properly configured; notify accommodation coordinator of configuration gap; apply accommodation settings from approved profile; verify assistive technology compatibility before exam resumption; document accommodation delivery for compliance record; extend timer appropriately for accommodation-related delays

# === LEVEL 5: EVENTS ===

Event: ExamSessionStarted
    On test-taker successfully authenticated and exam form delivered
    Action: Activate server-side timer; begin proctoring session recording; initialize auto-save mechanism; send session start confirmation to test-taker; log session start in audit trail; update exam administration real-time dashboard

Event: ExamResponseSubmitted
    On test-taker submits response to individual exam item
    Action: Save response with atomic write confirmation; validate response format; update answer snapshot for recovery; run real-time integrity check; update progress tracking; recalculate remaining time estimate

Event: ExamSessionCompleted
    On test-taker submits final exam or timer expires with auto-submission
    Action: Capture final answer snapshot; terminate proctoring session; trigger auto-grading pipeline; generate session completion audit record; send completion confirmation to test-taker; schedule result publication per configured timeline

Event: IntegrityIncidentEscalated
    On proctoring incident escalated to human reviewer after AI flagging
    Action: Assign incident to qualified reviewer queue; provide full evidence package including video clips; set review SLA of 4 hours for high-severity incidents; notify test-taker of pending review (without details); preserve all session data for investigation; update integrity incident dashboard

Event: ExamGraded
    On all items in exam session receive final grading (auto or human)
    Action: Calculate final score with all rubric adjustments; generate detailed score report; apply grading scale for letter grade if configured; update test-taker exam history; prepare result for publication on configured date; trigger score challenge window; generate item-level analytics contribution

Event: ScoreChallengeFiled
    On test-taker submits formal score challenge within challenge window
    Action: Create challenge record with test-taker justification; assign to independent grader for review; preserve original grading for comparison; set 5-business-day resolution SLA; notify test-taker of challenge receipt and timeline; update grade upon resolution if warranted; log challenge outcome for grading quality tracking

# === LEVEL 6: CONCURRENCY ===

Parallel:
    Exam form generation and content encryption executing concurrently for just-in-time delivery
    Response saving and integrity checking running simultaneously during active exam sessions
    AI proctoring analysis and live proctor monitoring executing in parallel for comprehensive coverage
    Auto-grading for objective items and NLP-based subjective grading running concurrently
    Answer similarity detection across test-takers and individual behavior analysis executing simultaneously
    Accessibility accommodation processing and exam configuration running in parallel at session start
    Real-time analytics aggregation and exam dashboard updates executing concurrently during administration

# === LEVEL 7: OPTIMIZATION ===

Optimize: Exam session reliability and zero data loss
    Priority: Achieve 99.99% session completion rate without data loss; maintain auto-save recovery for 100% of interruptions; ensure timer accuracy within 1 second per hour

Optimize: Question bank retrieval and form generation speed
    Priority: Generate statistically equivalent exam forms within 3 seconds; support 50,000+ item bank with sub-second item retrieval; optimize IRT-based selection algorithm performance

Optimize: Proctoring accuracy and false positive reduction
    Priority: Achieve 95% true positive detection rate for cheating behaviors; reduce false positive rate below 5%; process video analysis within 2 seconds of event occurrence

Optimize: Auto-grading accuracy and throughput
    Priority: Achieve 99.5% grading accuracy for objective items; process 10,000 exams per hour; reduce subjective grading turnaround to under 24 hours

Optimize: System scalability during peak exam windows
    Priority: Support 50,000 concurrent exam sessions; achieve page load time under 2 seconds during peak; maintain response save latency under 500ms

# === LEVEL 8: LEARNING ===

Learn: Cheating behavior classification model
    Goal: Classify proctoring incidents as genuine violations or benign behaviors with 92% accuracy
    Adapt: Proctoring sensitivity thresholds and flag severity assignments
    Based: Labeled incident outcomes, reviewer decisions, and behavioral feature analysis across thousands of exam sessions

Learn: Optimal exam form assembly
    Goal: Generate exam forms that maximize information gain while maintaining content balance and statistical equivalence
    Adapt: Item selection algorithm parameters and blueprint constraint weights
    Based: IRT item parameters, form-level reliability predictions, and content coverage optimization

Learn: Subjective grading automation
    Goal: Achieve human-equivalent grading accuracy for essay and short-answer items with 88% agreement rate
    Adapt: NLP grading model rubric interpretation and partial credit assignment
    Based: Expert human grading examples, inter-rater agreement patterns, and rubric application consistency data

Learn: Test-taker performance prediction
    Goal: Predict exam performance from pre-exam features with 75% accuracy for early intervention
    Adapt: Pre-exam preparation recommendations and targeted study materials
    Based: Historical performance trajectories, practice assessment results, and engagement metrics

Learn: Accessibility accommodation effectiveness
    Goal: Predict optimal accommodation configurations that maximize test-taker performance with 70% accuracy
    Adapt: Accommodation recommendation engine and default configuration selection
    Based: Accommodation-outcome correlation data, assistive technology compatibility ratings, and test-taker feedback

# === LEVEL 9: SECURITY ===

Security:
    Encrypt: All exam content at rest using AES-256 with per-form unique keys and just-in-time decryption
    Encrypt: Test-taker responses in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest with field-level encryption
    Encrypt: Proctoring video and audio data with end-to-end encryption and access-controlled playback
    Protect: Question bank items with role-based access controls, watermarking, and usage tracking
    Protect: Exam forms with test-taker-specific encryption preventing content extraction
    Protect: Grading results with sealed grading mode preventing score access until publication date
    Protect: Test-taker identity with pseudonymized grading to prevent grader bias
    Protect: Integrity investigation data with chain-of-custody documentation and access logging
    Protect: API endpoints with OAuth 2.0, rate limiting, and session-bound tokens
    Protect: Score data with row-level security ensuring test-takers access only their own results

# === LEVEL 10: NATIVE ===

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import hashlib
import random
import statistics

class ExaminationSystem:
    def __init__(self, db, proctoring_service, grading_engine, question_bank, analytics):
        self.db = db
        self.proctoring = proctoring_service
        self.grading = grading_engine
        self.qbank = question_bank
        self.analytics = analytics
        self.active_sessions = {}
        self.integrity_thresholds = {
            "similarity_max": 0.85,
            "response_time_anomaly_std": 3.0,
            "gaze_deviation_max": 0.4,
            "tab_switch_max": 2,
        }

    def generate_exam_form(self, exam_id: str, test_taker_id: str, accommodations: List[str] = None) -> Dict:
        exam = self.db.get("exams", exam_id)
        blueprint = exam["questionBlueprint"]
        items = self.qbank.select_items(
            subject=exam["subjectCode"],
            blueprint=blueprint,
            strategy="IRT_OPTIMAL",
            exclude_used_for=test_taker_id
        )

        total_marks = sum(item.get("maximumMarks", 1) for item in items)
        form = {
            "formId": f"FORM-{exam_id}-{test_taker_id}-{hashlib.sha256(f'{exam_id}{test_taker_id}{datetime.now().isoformat()}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}",
            "examId": exam_id,
            "testTakerId": test_taker_id,
            "items": items,
            "totalMarks": total_marks,
            "durationMinutes": self._apply_time_accommodation(exam["durationMinutes"], accommodations or []),
            "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }

        accommodation_mods = self._apply_accommodations(form, accommodations or [])
        return {
            "form": form,
            "validation": self._validate_form(form, blueprint),
            "deliveryConfig": accommodation_mods,
        }

    def adminiser_exam(self, session_id: str, test_taker_id: str, security: Dict, proctor_config: Dict) -> Dict:
        identity_verified = self._verify_identity(test_taker_id, security)
        if not identity_verified:
            return {"error": "Identity verification failed", "code": "AUTH_FAILED"}

        proctor_session = self.proctoring.initialize_session(
            test_taker_id=test_taker_id,
            mode=proctor_config.get("mode", "AI_ASSISTED"),
            sensitivity=proctor_config.get("sensitivity", "STANDARD"),
        )

        session = {
            "sessionId": session_id,
            "testTakerId": test_taker_id,
            "actualStart": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "sessionStatus": "IN_PROGRESS",
            "proctorSessionId": proctor_session["sessionId"],
            "answerSnapshot": {},
            "autoSaveCount": 0,
            "connectionInterruptions": 0,
            "flaggedIncidents": [],
        }
        self.active_sessions[session_id] = session
        self.db.insert("exam_sessions", session)

        return {
            "sessionState": session,
            "proctoringStatus": proctor_session,
            "timerConfig": {"syncIntervalMs": 1000, "ntpServer": "pool.ntp.org"},
        }

    def process_response(self, session_id: str, item_id: str, response: any, client_meta: Dict) -> Dict:
        session = self.active_sessions.get(session_id)
        if not session:
            return {"error": "Session not found"}

        session["answerSnapshot"][item_id] = {
            "response": response,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "clientMetadata": client_meta,
        }
        session["autoSaveCount"] += 1

        integrity = self._check_response_integrity(session_id, item_id, response, client_meta)

        self.db.update("exam_sessions", {"sessionId": session_id}, {"answerSnapshot": session["answerSnapshot"]})

        return {
            "saved": True,
            "integrityCheck": integrity,
            "autoSaveNumber": session["autoSaveCount"],
        }

    def auto_grade_exam(self, session_id: str, exam_id: str) -> Dict:
        session = self.db.get("exam_sessions", session_id)
        exam = self.db.get("exams", exam_id)
        responses = session.get("answerSnapshot", {})

        results = []
        flagged_for_human = []
        total_score = 0

        for item_id, response_data in responses.items():
            item = self.qbank.get_item(item_id)
            grade_result = self.grading.grade_item(
                item=item,
                response=response_data["response"],
                rubric=item.get("scoringRubric", {}),
            )

            result = {
                "sessionId": session_id,
                "itemId": item_id,
                "awardedMarks": grade_result["marks"],
                "maximumMarks": item.get("maximumMarks", 1),
                "gradingMethod": grade_result["method"],
                "gradingConfidence": grade_result["confidence"],
            }

            if grade_result["confidence"] < 0.85:
                flagged_for_human.append(result)
                result["challengeStatus"] = "PENDING_REVIEW"

            results.append(result)
            total_score += grade_result["marks"]

        return {
            "scoreReport": {
                "totalScore": total_score,
                "totalMarks": exam["totalMarks"],
                "percentage": (total_score / exam["totalMarks"] * 100) if exam["totalMarks"] > 0 else 0,
                "passed": total_score >= exam["passingMarks"],
            },
            "itemResults": results,
            "flaggedItems": flagged_for_human,
            "humanReviewRequired": len(flagged_for_human) > 0,
        }

    def detect_integrity_violation(self, session_id: str) -> Dict:
        session = self.active_sessions.get(session_id)
        if not session:
            return {"error": "Session not found"}

        proctor_incidents = self.proctoring.get_incidents(session["proctorSessionId"])
        response_analysis = self._analyze_response_patterns(session_id)
        similarity = self._check_response_similarity(session_id)

        all_flags = []
        risk_score = 0.0

        for incident in proctor_incidents:
            if incident["confidence"] >= 0.6:
                all_flags.append({"type": "PROCTORING", "detail": incident})
                risk_score = max(risk_score, incident["confidence"])

        if response_analysis["anomalous"]:
            all_flags.append({"type": "RESPONSE_PATTERN", "detail": response_analysis})
            risk_score = max(risk_score, 0.7)

        if similarity["maxSimilarity"] > self.integrity_thresholds["similarity_max"]:
            all_flags.append({"type": "SIMILARITY", "detail": similarity})
            risk_score = max(risk_score, similarity["maxSimilarity"])

        return {
            "sessionId": session_id,
            "riskScore": risk_score,
            "flaggedBehaviors": all_flags,
            "evidencePackage": self._compile_evidence(session, all_flags),
        }

    def _apply_time_accommodation(self, base_minutes: int, accommodations: List[str]) -> int:
        multiplier = 1.0
        for acc in accommodations:
            if "extended_time_1.5x" in acc:
                multiplier = max(multiplier, 1.5)
            elif "extended_time_2x" in acc:
                multiplier = max(multiplier, 2.0)
        return int(base_minutes * multiplier)

    def _apply_accommodations(self, form: Dict, accommodations: List[str]) -> Dict:
        config = {"screenReader": False, "highContrast": False, "fontSize": "normal", "responseFormat": "standard"}
        for acc in accommodations:
            if "screen_reader" in acc:
                config["screenReader"] = True
            elif "high_contrast" in acc:
                config["highContrast"] = True
            elif "large_font" in acc:
                config["fontSize"] = "large"
            elif "speech_to_text" in acc:
                config["responseFormat"] = "audio"
        return config

    def _validate_form(self, form: Dict, blueprint: Dict) -> Dict:
        topic_coverage = {}
        for item in form["items"]:
            topic = item.get("topicCode", "unknown")
            topic_coverage[topic] = topic_coverage.get(topic, 0) + 1
        return {"valid": True, "topicCoverage": topic_coverage}

    def _verify_identity(self, test_taker_id: str, security: Dict) -> bool:
        return security.get("identityVerified", False)

    def _check_response_integrity(self, session_id: str, item_id: str, response: any, meta: Dict) -> Dict:
        return {"passed": True, "flags": []}

    def _analyze_response_patterns(self, session_id: str) -> Dict:
        return {"anomalous": False, "details": {}}

    def _check_response_similarity(self, session_id: str) -> Dict:
        return {"maxSimilarity": 0.3, "similarSessions": []}

    def _compile_evidence(self, session: Dict, flags: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        return {"sessionId": session["sessionId"], "flagCount": len(flags), "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()}
}

# AICL Example: Smart Grid Management System
# Intelligent smart grid management covering demand response, load balancing, renewable integration, outage management, and billing

# === LEVEL 1: ARCHITECTURE ===

Goal: Build an intelligent smart grid management platform that optimizes electricity distribution through real-time demand response, autonomous load balancing, seamless renewable energy integration, proactive outage management, and accurate consumer billing while ensuring grid stability, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

Constraint: Grid control commands must achieve sub-second latency from decision to execution for frequency regulation and protection relay coordination.

Constraint: System must support NERC CIP compliance for critical infrastructure protection including cybersecurity standards.

Constraint: Renewable generation forecasting must achieve accuracy above 90% for 24-hour ahead solar and 85% for wind predictions.

Constraint: Billing must support net metering, time-of-use rates, demand charges, and distributed energy resource compensation.

Risk: Cascading grid failure from protection relay miscoordination could cause widespread blackout affecting millions of consumers.
Recovery: Implement defense-in-depth relay coordination with independent verification; deploy automatic load shedding with under-frequency protection; activate islanding detection and microgrid separation protocols; engage emergency coordination with neighboring grid operators; restore system using black-start generators per restoration plan.

Risk: Renewable generation forecast error could cause supply-demand imbalance and frequency deviation.
Recovery: Maintain spinning reserve margin exceeding forecast uncertainty; deploy fast-acting battery storage for ramp-rate compensation; implement dynamic operating reserve adjustment based on forecast confidence; activate demand response resources for rapid load reduction; curtail renewable output only as last resort with market compensation.

Risk: Cybersecurity breach of SCADA systems could enable remote manipulation of grid infrastructure.
Recovery: Implement air-gapped safety systems with manual override capability; deploy network segmentation with unidirectional gateways for control traffic; activate intrusion detection with automatic circuit breaker on anomalous commands; isolate compromised systems while maintaining grid operations through backup control; engage NERC CIP incident response team within 30 minutes.

Risk: Billing system errors from smart meter data corruption could cause widespread consumer billing disputes.
Recovery: Implement meter data validation with statistical outlier detection; maintain dual-path meter reading with reconciliation; generate estimated bills based on historical consumption when data is suspect; deploy automated bill correction and customer notification; audit meter data integrity on daily schedule.

Risk: Demand response event failure during peak load could result in grid overload and equipment damage.
Recovery: Implement staged demand response activation with escalating signals; deploy direct load control as automatic fallback; activate emergency load shedding as last resort; maintain critical infrastructure supply priority; compensate participating consumers per tariff schedule; post-event analysis for demand response program improvement.

Risk: DER interconnection issues could cause voltage regulation problems and power quality degradation.
Recovery: Implement real-time voltage monitoring at DER interconnection points; deploy smart inverter volt-VAR optimization; activate automatic DER curtailment for voltage exceedance; engage utility-scale voltage regulation equipment; notify DER operators of interconnection issues; update hosting capacity maps based on observed conditions.

Layer: SmartGridManagement
    SubLayer: GridOperations
        # SCADA interface, frequency regulation, load balancing, protection coordination
    SubLayer: DemandResponse
        # DR events, load control, consumer programs, baseline calculation
    SubLayer: RenewableIntegration
        # Generation forecasting, DER management, curtailment, grid services
    SubLayer: OutageManagement
        # Fault detection, crew dispatch, restoration tracking, customer communication
    SubLayer: MeteringAndBilling
        # Smart meter data, rate calculation, net metering, billing generation

Validation: Grid frequency maintained within ±0.05 Hz of nominal under normal operating conditions.
Validation: Protection relay coordination validated against short-circuit study results annually.
Validation: Demand response event baseline validated using 10-day comparable baseline methodology.
Validation: Renewable generation forecast accuracy validated against actual generation on rolling 30-day basis.
Validation: Smart meter data validated against consumption reasonableness checks and tamper detection.
Validation: Billing calculations validated against rate tariff schedules with zero tolerance for rate misapplication.
Validation: DER interconnection compliance validated against IEEE 1547 standard requirements.

# === LEVEL 3: BEHAVIORS ===

Behavior BalanceGridLoad
    Input: currentDemand: float, currentSupply: float, frequencyDeviation: float, reserveMargin: float
    Output: dispatchOrders: list, loadShedActions: list, reserveAdjustments: dict
    Action:
        Monitor real-time frequency deviation and Area Control Error
        Calculate supply-demand balance across all control areas
        Prioritize dispatch based on marginal cost and ramp capability
        Activate spinning reserve if frequency deviation exceeds threshold
        Issue demand response signals if supply deficit persists
        Implement automatic load shedding as last resort per priority scheme
        Log all dispatch decisions with timestamps and rationale

Behavior ForecastRenewableGeneration
    Input: assetId: string, forecastHorizon: integer, weatherData: dict, historicalData: dict
    Output: forecastSeries: list, confidenceIntervals: list, rampEvents: list
    Action:
        Ingest numerical weather prediction data from multiple models
        Apply machine learning ensemble combining physical and statistical models
        Generate probabilistic forecasts with confidence intervals
        Identify significant ramp events requiring advanced preparation
        Update forecasts every 15 minutes with latest observations
        Compare forecast accuracy against actual generation for model improvement

    Output: enrolledResources: list, expectedReduction: float, notificationResults: list
    Action:

        Issue demand response dispatch signals to enrolled resources
        Track real-time load reduction against baseline and target
        Calculate performance compliance scores for each resource
        Generate post-event settlement and consumer compensation
        Update demand response program analytics and resource ratings

Behavior DetectAndManageOutage
    Input: faultIndicators: dict, circuitId: string, protectionEvents: list, customerReports: list
    Output: outageRecord: dict, crewDispatch: dict, customerNotifications: list
    Action:
        Correlate fault indicators from SCADA and smart meter data
        Determine outage scope using connectivity model and meter pings
        Classify outage cause from protection relay event analysis
        Dispatch repair crew with fault location and safety information
        Generate customer notifications with estimated restoration time
        Track restoration progress with real-time crew location updates
        Update outage management system with restoration confirmation
